question_en: What does this yellow diamond sign showing two schoolchildren walking briskly warn drivers about?
question_ms: Apakah amaran yang diberikan oleh tanda berlian kuning yang memaparkan dua orang murid sekolah sedang melintas ini?
options_en: Children's playground ahead
School children crossing zone ahead
Pedestrian track mandatory requiring selection of a lower transmission ratio
No pedestrians allowed
options_ms: Taman permainan kanak-kanak di hadapan
Kawasan kanak-kanak sekolah melintas di hadapan
Laluan pejalan kaki mandatori yang memerlukan pemilihan nisbah gear yang lebih rendah
Pejalan kaki dilarang melintas
explanation_en: School children crossing zone ahead. Recommended action: Observe the 30 km/h school-zone speed limit and obey any school crossing warden's stop paddle.
explanation_ms: Kawasan kanak-kanak sekolah melintas di hadapan. Tindakan disyorkan: Patuhi had laju zon sekolah 30 km/j dan patuhi arahan penjaga lintasan sekolah.

question_en: What does this yellow rectangular enforcement sign headed 'ZON TUNDA' depicting a tow truck pulling a car mean?
question_ms: Apakah maksud papan tanda penguatkuasaan berwarna kuning bertulis 'ZON TUNDA' yang memaparkan lori tunda menarik kereta ini?
options_en: Breakdown recovery service station on high-volume single carriageway trunk routes
Vehicle inspection weighbridge
Tow-away enforcement zone (Zon Tunda) — illegally parked vehicles will be towed
Car ferry loading ramp
options_ms: Stesen perkhidmatan tunda kerosakan di laluan jalan raya tunggal dengan aliran trafik yang tinggi
Stesen timbang pemeriksaan kenderaan
Zon Tunda — kenderaan yang diletakkan secara menghalang atau tanpa kebenaran akan ditunda
Tanjakan muatan feri kereta
explanation_en: Tow-away enforcement zone (Zon Tunda) — illegally parked vehicles will be towed. Recommended action: Do not park or leave your vehicle unattended anywhere within this enforcement zone.
explanation_ms: Zon Tunda — kenderaan yang diletakkan secara menghalang atau tanpa kebenaran akan ditunda. Tindakan disyorkan: Jangan meletakkan atau meninggalkan kenderaan anda tanpa pengawasan di dalam zon penguatkuasaan ini.

question_en: What level crossing ahead is indicated by this yellow diamond sign showing the silhouette of a steam locomotive?
question_ms: Apakah jenis lintasan di hadapan yang ditunjukkan oleh tanda berlian kuning dengan simbol kepala kereta api ini?
options_en: Gated railway crossing ahead
LRT station park-and-ride ahead
Tram lane only ahead located within 100 metres before the main roadway junction
Level railway crossing without gates ahead
options_ms: Lintasan kereta api berpagar di hadapan
Stesen LRT parkir dan gerak di hadapan
Lorong trem sahaja di hadapan dalam jarak 100 meter sebelum tiba di persimpangan jalan
Lintasan kereta api tanpa pagar di hadapan
explanation_en: Level railway crossing without gates ahead. Recommended action: Slow down, look and listen in both directions for approaching trains, and stop if a train is near.
explanation_ms: Lintasan kereta api tanpa pagar di hadapan. Tindakan disyorkan: Perlahankan kenderaan, lihat dan dengar ke kiri dan kanan bagi kereta api yang menghampiri, dan berhenti jika perlu.

question_en: What does this yellow diamond sign showing a pedestrian walking between dashed lines indicate?
question_ms: Apakah maksud tanda berlian kuning yang memaparkan pejalan kaki melintas di antara garisan putus-putus?
options_en: Marked pedestrian crossing (Lintasan Pejalan Kaki) ahead
Pedestrian bridge overhead
Pedestrians prohibited ahead
Jogging track ahead
options_ms: Lintasan pejalan kaki di hadapan
Jejantas pejalan kaki di atas
Pejalan kaki dilarang masuk
Trek larian di hadapan
explanation_en: Marked pedestrian crossing (Lintasan Pejalan Kaki) ahead. Recommended action: Approach at a controlled speed and stop behind the line if any pedestrian is on or waiting to use the crossing.
explanation_ms: Lintasan pejalan kaki di hadapan. Tindakan disyorkan: Hampiri dengan kelajuan terkawal dan berhenti jika terdapat pejalan kaki sedang atau hendak melintas.

question_en: What does this yellow diamond sign showing a black lattice fence/gate without text below it indicate?
question_ms: Apakah maksud tanda berlian kuning yang memaparkan simbol pagar hitam tanpa tulisan di bawahnya?
options_en: Farm fence across road ahead
Gated railway level crossing (Lintasan Bertingkat Berpagar) ahead
Road closed for bridge repairs
Toll plaza barrier ahead where oncoming traffic has priority of movement
options_ms: Pagar ladang merentangi jalan di hadapan
Lintasan kereta api berpagar di hadapan
Jalan ditutup untuk pembaikan jambatan
Palang plaza tol di hadapan di mana aliran trafik bertentangan diberi keutamaan jalan
explanation_en: Gated railway level crossing (Lintasan Bertingkat Berpagar) ahead. Recommended action: Reduce speed and prepare to stop behind the white line whenever warning bells ring or gates begin to close.
explanation_ms: Lintasan kereta api berpagar di hadapan. Tindakan disyorkan: Kurangkan kelajuan dan bersedia berhenti di belakang garisan putih apabila loceng amaran berbunyi atau pagar ditutup.

question_en: What does this yellow diamond sign showing a railway gate with the sub-plate 'AUTO' mean?
question_ms: Apakah maksud tanda berlian kuning dengan simbol pagar kereta api dan papan tambahan 'AUTO'?
options_en: Automated Touch 'n Go / RFID toll lane
Automatic car wash ahead requiring steady deceleration before reaching the zone
Automatic gated railway level crossing (AUTO) ahead
Automatic factory gate ahead
options_ms: Lorong tol automatik Touch 'n Go / RFID
Pusat cucian kereta automatik di hadapan yang memerlukan pengurangan kelajuan sebelum tiba di lokasi
Pagar lintasan kereta api automatik (AUTO) di hadapan
Pintu pagar kilang automatik di hadapan
explanation_en: Automatic gated railway level crossing (AUTO) ahead. Recommended action: Never attempt to zigzag around or beat the automatic barriers once the red lights start flashing.
explanation_ms: Pagar lintasan kereta api automatik (AUTO) di hadapan. Tindakan disyorkan: Jangan sesekali cuba mencelah atau melepasi palang automatik sebaik sahaja lampu merah mula berkelip.

question_en: What weather hazard is indicated by this yellow diamond sign showing a red windsock blowing horizontally from a pole?
question_ms: Apakah bahaya cuaca yang ditunjukkan oleh tanda berlian kuning dengan simbol stoking angin merah yang ditiup melintang pada tiang ini?
options_en: Low-flying aircraft near runway with a continuous central dividing median barrier
Weather station ahead
Kite-flying recreational zone
Strong side winds / crosswind area ahead (Lintasan Angin Lintang)
options_ms: Pesawat terbang rendah berhampiran landasan
Stesen kaji cuaca di hadapan
Zon rekreasi permainan layang-layang
Kawasan angin lintang kuat di hadapan
explanation_en: Strong side winds / crosswind area ahead (Lintasan Angin Lintang). Recommended action: Grip the steering wheel firmly with both hands and reduce speed, especially when passing open viaducts or overtaking lorries.
explanation_ms: Kawasan angin lintang kuat di hadapan. Tindakan disyorkan: Pegang stereng dengan kemas menggunakan kedua-dua tangan dan kurangkan kelajuan, terutamanya di jejambat terbuka atau ketika memotong lori.

question_en: What traffic pattern ahead is indicated by this yellow diamond sign where an angled right line joins a vertical arrow?
question_ms: Apakah corak aliran trafik di hadapan yang ditunjukkan oleh tanda berlian kuning di mana garisan serong kanan bercantum ke anak panah menegak?
options_en: Traffic merging from the right slip road ahead
Side road T-junction ahead
Overtaking lane begins ahead
Road narrows on the right
options_ms: Aliran trafik bercantum dari susur masuk sebelah kanan di hadapan
Simpang T di hadapan
Lorong memotong bermula di hadapan
Jalan menyempit di sebelah kanan
explanation_en: Traffic merging from the right slip road ahead. Recommended action: Check your mirrors and adjust speed courteously so merging vehicles can join safely.
explanation_ms: Aliran trafik bercantum dari susur masuk sebelah kanan di hadapan. Tindakan disyorkan: Periksa cermin dan laraskan kelajuan secara berhemah supaya kenderaan dari susur dapat bercantum dengan selamat.

question_en: What does this yellow diamond sign showing a staggered junction with a yellow criss-cross box in the middle indicate?
question_ms: Apakah maksud tanda berlian kuning yang memaparkan simpang bersilang dengan petak kuning berjalur di tengahnya?
options_en: Uncontrolled rural crossroads requiring selection of a lower transmission ratio
Controlled staggered junction with yellow box ahead
Railway crossing box ahead
Toll booth plaza ahead
options_ms: Persimpangan luar bandar tanpa kawalan yang memerlukan pemilihan nisbah gear yang lebih rendah
Persimpangan terkawal petak kuning di hadapan
Petak lintasan kereta api di hadapan
Plaza tol di hadapan
explanation_en: Controlled staggered junction with yellow box ahead. Recommended action: Do not enter the yellow box junction unless your exit lane is completely clear.
explanation_ms: Persimpangan terkawal petak kuning di hadapan. Tindakan disyorkan: Jangan memasuki petak kuning di persimpangan melainkan laluan keluar anda benar-benar kosong.

question_en: What does this yellow diamond sign showing two curved arrows passing to the left and right of a central black circle indicate?
question_ms: Apakah maksud tanda berlian kuning yang memaparkan dua anak panah melengkung di kiri dan kanan bulatan hitam di tengah?
options_en: Roundabout ahead
Road closed in both directions
Obstruction in the center of the road ahead — pass on either side
Dual carriageway ends ahead on high-volume single carriageway trunk routes
options_ms: Bulatan di hadapan
Jalan ditutup di kedua-dua arah
Halangan di tengah jalan di hadapan — laluan di sebelah kiri atau kanan
Jalan berkembar berakhir di hadapan di laluan jalan raya tunggal dengan aliran trafik yang tinggi
explanation_en: Obstruction in the center of the road ahead — pass on either side. Recommended action: Slow down and steer smoothly into the left or right lane around the central island.
explanation_ms: Halangan di tengah jalan di hadapan — laluan di sebelah kiri atau kanan. Tindakan disyorkan: Perlahankan kenderaan dan pandu dengan cermat di lorong kiri atau kanan mengelilingi halangan tengah.

question_en: What prohibition is enforced by this circular white sign with a red border, diagonal slash, and a red car beside a black car?
question_ms: Apakah larangan yang dikuatkuasakan oleh tanda bulatan putih bersempadan merah dengan palang serong serta simbol kereta merah di sebelah kereta hitam?
options_en: No driving side-by-side on expressways
Two-way traffic prohibited located within 100 metres before the main roadway junction
Cars prohibited from entering
Overtaking is strictly prohibited
options_ms: Dilarang memandu beriringan di lebuh raya
Lalu lintas dua hala dilarang
Kereta dilarang masuk
Dilarang memotong
explanation_en: Overtaking is strictly prohibited. Recommended action: Remain in your lane behind the vehicle ahead until you pass the end of the no-overtaking zone.
explanation_ms: Dilarang memotong. Tindakan disyorkan: Kekal di lorong anda di belakang kenderaan hadapan sehingga melepasi zon larangan memotong.

question_en: What does this red-bordered circular sign showing a lorry on the left and a passenger car on the right crossed by a red slash mean?
question_ms: Apakah maksud tanda bulatan bersempadan merah yang memaparkan simbol lori di sebelah kiri dan kereta di sebelah kanan dengan palang merah?
options_en: Heavy goods vehicles / lorries are prohibited from overtaking
Lorries prohibited from entering the road
Passenger cars may not overtake lorries
Dedicated convoy lane for lorries and cars
options_ms: Kenderaan berat / lori dilarang memotong
Lori dilarang memasuki jalan ini
Kereta penumpang dilarang memotong lori
Lorong konvoi khas untuk lori dan kereta
explanation_en: Heavy goods vehicles / lorries are prohibited from overtaking. Recommended action: Lorries and heavy vehicles must stay in the left lane and not overtake other vehicles.
explanation_ms: Kenderaan berat / lori dilarang memotong. Tindakan disyorkan: Lori dan kenderaan berat mesti kekal di lorong kiri dan dilarang memotong kenderaan lain.

question_en: What is prohibited by this red-bordered circular sign depicting a black horn crossed out by a red diagonal bar?
question_ms: Apakah perkara yang dilarang oleh tanda bulatan bersempadan merah yang memaparkan simbol hon hitam dipalang dengan garisan merah?
options_en: Musical instruments prohibited
Sounding the vehicle horn is prohibited (e.g., near hospitals, schools, or courts)
Exhaust noise test station ahead where oncoming traffic has priority of movement requiring steady deceleration before reaching the zone
Radio transmitters must be switched off
options_ms: Alat muzik dilarang
Dilarang membunyikan hon (contohnya berhampiran hospital, sekolah atau mahkamah)
Stesen ujian bunyi ekzos di hadapan di mana aliran trafik bertentangan diberi keutamaan jalan
Pemancar radio mesti dimatikan
explanation_en: Sounding the vehicle horn is prohibited (e.g., near hospitals, schools, or courts). Recommended action: Refrain from using the horn in this quiet zone except to prevent an immediate collision emergency.
explanation_ms: Dilarang membunyikan hon (contohnya berhampiran hospital, sekolah atau mahkamah). Tindakan disyorkan: Jangan membunyikan hon di zon senyap ini kecuali untuk mengelakkan bahaya perlanggaran serta-merta.

question_en: What does this solid red circular sign with a thick white horizontal bar across the center mean?
question_ms: Apakah maksud tanda bulatan penuh berwarna merah dengan satu palang melintang berwarna putih di tengahnya?
options_en: No stopping at any time requiring steady deceleration before reaching the zone
Road closed to heavy lorries only
No Entry for all vehicles (Dilarang Masuk)
Stop at the white line before entering
options_ms: Dilarang berhenti pada bila-bila masa
Jalan ditutup kepada lori berat sahaja
Dilarang masuk bagi semua kenderaan
Berhenti di garisan putih sebelum masuk
explanation_en: No Entry for all vehicles (Dilarang Masuk). Recommended action: Do not enter this road or slip lane as traffic flows in the opposite direction.
explanation_ms: Dilarang masuk bagi semua kenderaan. Tindakan disyorkan: Jangan memasuki jalan atau lorong ini kerana aliran trafik adalah dari arah bertentangan.

question_en: What maneuver is prohibited by this red-bordered circular sign showing a left-turning arrow crossed by a red diagonal slash?
question_ms: Apakah pergerakan yang dilarang oleh tanda bulatan bersempadan merah dengan anak panah membelok ke kiri yang dipalang merah?
options_en: Sharp bend to the left ahead
Mandatory left turn only
No U-turn to the left with a continuous central dividing median barrier
No Left Turn permitted at this junction
options_ms: Selekoh tajam ke kiri di hadapan
Wajib belok kiri sahaja
Dilarang pusingan U ke kiri dengan pembahagi jalan konkrit berterusan di hadapan
Dilarang belok kiri di persimpangan ini
explanation_en: No Left Turn permitted at this junction. Recommended action: Proceed straight ahead or turn right if permitted; do not turn into the road on the left.
explanation_ms: Dilarang belok kiri di persimpangan ini. Tindakan disyorkan: Pandu terus atau belok kanan jika dibenarkan; jangan membelok ke jalan di sebelah kiri.

question_en: What maneuver is prohibited by this red-bordered circular sign showing a right-turning arrow crossed by a red diagonal slash?
question_ms: Apakah pergerakan yang dilarang oleh tanda bulatan bersempadan merah dengan anak panah membelok ke kanan yang dipalang merah?
options_en: No Right Turn permitted at this junction
Sharp bend to the right ahead
Mandatory right turn only
Right lane closed ahead
options_ms: Dilarang belok kanan di persimpangan ini
Selekoh tajam ke kanan di hadapan
Wajib belok kanan sahaja
Lorong kanan ditutup di hadapan
explanation_en: No Right Turn permitted at this junction. Recommended action: Proceed straight ahead or turn left if permitted; do not turn across traffic to the right.
explanation_ms: Dilarang belok kanan di persimpangan ini. Tindakan disyorkan: Pandu terus atau belok kiri jika dibenarkan; jangan membelok ke sebelah kanan.

question_en: What does this red-bordered circular sign with a two-way left-and-right branching arrow crossed by a red slash prohibit?
question_ms: Apakah yang dilarang oleh tanda bulatan bersempadan merah dengan anak panah bercabang ke kiri dan kanan yang dipalang merah ini?
options_en: T-junction closed ahead
Both left and right turns are prohibited
Crossroads ahead warning
Detour to left and right requiring selection of a lower transmission ratio
options_ms: Simpang T ditutup di hadapan
Dilarang belok kiri dan kanan
Amaran simpang empat di hadapan
Lencongan ke kiri dan kanan yang memerlukan pemilihan nisbah gear yang lebih rendah
explanation_en: Both left and right turns are prohibited. Recommended action: You must proceed straight ahead through the intersection without turning left or right.
explanation_ms: Dilarang belok kiri dan kanan. Tindakan disyorkan: Anda mesti memandu terus melalui persimpangan tanpa membelok ke kiri atau ke kanan.

question_en: What maneuver is forbidden by this red-bordered circular sign showing a 180-degree hairpin arrow crossed by a red slash?
question_ms: Apakah pergerakan yang dilarang oleh tanda bulatan bersempadan merah dengan anak panah berpusing 180 darjah yang dipalang merah?
options_en: U-turn permitted ahead
Hairpin bend ahead on high-volume single carriageway trunk routes
No U-Turn permitted (Dilarang Berpusing Balik)
No right turn
options_ms: Pusingan U dibenarkan di hadapan
Selekoh tajam berbentuk U di hadapan di laluan jalan raya tunggal dengan aliran trafik yang tinggi
Dilarang berpusing balik / membuat pusingan U
Dilarang belok kanan
explanation_en: No U-Turn permitted (Dilarang Berpusing Balik). Recommended action: Continue forward to the next designated U-turn facility or roundabout.
explanation_ms: Dilarang berpusing balik / membuat pusingan U. Tindakan disyorkan: Teruskan pemanduan ke kemudahan pusingan U atau bulatan yang dibenarkan di hadapan.

question_en: Which road users are barred from entering when this red-bordered circular sign showing a motorcycle and rider crossed by a red slash is posted?
question_ms: Pengguna jalan raya manakah yang dilarang masuk apabila tanda bulatan bersempadan merah dengan simbol motosikal berpalang merah ini dipamerkan?
options_en: Dedicated motorcycle track ahead located within 100 metres before the main roadway junction
Motorcycles may not overtake
Helmet enforcement checkpoint
Motorcycles are prohibited from entering this road or carriageway
options_ms: Laluan khas motosikal di hadapan dalam jarak 100 meter sebelum tiba di persimpangan jalan
Motosikal dilarang memotong
Sekatan pemeriksaan topi keledar
Motosikal dilarang masuk ke jalan atau laluan ini
explanation_en: Motorcycles are prohibited from entering this road or carriageway. Recommended action: Motorcycle riders must use the dedicated motorcycle lane or an alternative route.
explanation_ms: Motosikal dilarang masuk ke jalan atau laluan ini. Tindakan disyorkan: Penunggang motosikal mesti menggunakan lorong khas motosikal atau jalan alternatif.

question_en: Which road users are prohibited from entering when this red-bordered circular sign showing a pedal cycle crossed by a red slash is displayed?
question_ms: Pengguna jalan raya manakah yang dilarang masuk apabila tanda bulatan bersempadan merah dengan simbol basikal berpalang merah ini dipamerkan?
options_en: Bicycles and non-motorised cycles are prohibited from entering
Bicycle lane only
Children's playground ahead
Motorcycles prohibited
options_ms: Basikal dilarang masuk ke laluan ini
Laluan basikal sahaja
Taman permainan kanak-kanak di hadapan
Motosikal dilarang masuk
explanation_en: Bicycles and non-motorised cycles are prohibited from entering. Recommended action: Cyclists must use the designated cycle track or alternative road instead of this highway.
explanation_ms: Basikal dilarang masuk ke laluan ini. Tindakan disyorkan: Penunggang basikal mesti menggunakan laluan basikal yang disediakan dan bukannya lebuh raya ini.

question_en: What does this red-bordered circular sign showing a hooded trishaw (beca) crossed by a red diagonal bar mean?
question_ms: Apakah maksud tanda bulatan bersempadan merah yang memaparkan simbol beca dengan palang serong merah ini?
options_en: Trishaw lane only where oncoming traffic has priority of movement requiring steady deceleration before reaching the zone
Trishaws, handcarts, animal-drawn carts, and micromobility vehicles are prohibited
Pedestrian heritage zone
Agricultural vehicles only
options_ms: Laluan beca sahaja di mana aliran trafik bertentangan diberi keutamaan jalan yang memerlukan pengurangan kelajuan sebelum tiba di lokasi
Beca, kereta sorong, kereta lembu dan kenderaan mikromobiliti dilarang masuk
Zon warisan pejalan kaki
Kenderaan pertanian sahaja
explanation_en: Trishaws, handcarts, animal-drawn carts, and micromobility vehicles are prohibited. Recommended action: Slow non-motorised and micromobility vehicles must not use this fast carriageway.
explanation_ms: Beca, kereta sorong, kereta lembu dan kenderaan mikromobiliti dilarang masuk. Tindakan disyorkan: Kenderaan perlahan tidak bermotor serta mikromobiliti dilarang menggunakan laluan utama ini.

question_en: What does a circular sign with a blue background, red border, and a SINGLE red diagonal slash (without an X) mean?
question_ms: Apakah maksud papan tanda bulatan berlatar belakang biru, bersempadan merah, dan mempunyai SATU palang serong merah?
options_en: No stopping at any time
No entry for all vehicles
No Parking (Dilarang Meletak Kenderaan) — blue disc with red border and single diagonal bar
Speed restriction ends requiring steady deceleration before reaching the zone with a continuous central dividing median barrier
options_ms: Dilarang berhenti pada bila-bila masa
Dilarang masuk bagi semua kenderaan
Dilarang meletak kenderaan — bulatan biru bersempadan merah dengan satu palang serong merah
Had laju berakhir yang memerlukan pengurangan kelajuan sebelum tiba di lokasi dengan pembahagi jalan konkrit berterusan di hadapan
explanation_en: No Parking (Dilarang Meletak Kenderaan) — blue disc with red border and single diagonal bar. Recommended action: You may not park or leave your vehicle unattended here, though brief passenger drop-off without obstructing traffic may occur.
explanation_ms: Dilarang meletak kenderaan — bulatan biru bersempadan merah dengan satu palang serong merah. Tindakan disyorkan: Anda dilarang meletak atau meninggalkan kenderaan di sini.

question_en: What does a circular sign with a blue background, red border, and TWO crossed red diagonal bars forming an 'X' mean?
question_ms: Apakah maksud papan tanda bulatan berlatar belakang biru, bersempadan merah, dan mempunyai DUA palang merah bersilang bentuk 'X'?
options_en: No parking during office hours only
Road closed ahead with a continuous central dividing median barrier equipped with flashing amber hazard warning signals
Level crossing ahead
No Stopping at any time (Dilarang Berhenti) — blue disc with red border and red X cross
options_ms: Dilarang meletak kenderaan waktu pejabat sahaja
Jalan ditutup di hadapan dengan pembahagi jalan konkrit berterusan di hadapan yang dilengkapi lampu isyarat amaran jingga berkelip
Lintasan kereta api di hadapan
Dilarang berhenti pada bila-bila masa — bulatan biru bersempadan merah dengan palang X merah
explanation_en: No Stopping at any time (Dilarang Berhenti) — blue disc with red border and red X cross. Recommended action: Do not stop even briefly to pick up or set down passengers along this stretch of road.
explanation_ms: Dilarang berhenti pada bila-bila masa — bulatan biru bersempadan merah dengan palang X merah. Tindakan disyorkan: Jangan berhenti walaupun seketika untuk mengambil atau menurunkan penumpang di sepanjang laluan ini.

question_en: What is required by this eight-sided red octagonal sign bearing the white word 'BERHENTI'?
question_ms: Apakah tindakan wajib apabila menemui papan tanda oktagon lapan segi berwarna merah dengan perkataan putih 'BERHENTI' ini?
options_en: Mandatory Stop at intersection (Berhenti Di Persimpangan)
Slow down and merge without stopping
No entry into this street
Stop only if a police officer waves
options_ms: Berhenti di persimpangan (Tanda Oktagon BERHENTI)
Perlahankan kenderaan dan terus bercantum
Dilarang masuk ke jalan ini
Berhenti hanya jika diarahkan anggota polis
explanation_en: Mandatory Stop at intersection (Berhenti Di Persimpangan). Recommended action: Bring your vehicle to a complete halt behind the white stop line, check all directions, and proceed only when safe.
explanation_ms: Berhenti di persimpangan (Tanda Oktagon BERHENTI). Tindakan disyorkan: Berhentikan kenderaan sepenuhnya di belakang garisan berhenti putih, periksa semua arah, dan bergerak hanya apabila selamat.

question_en: What is the meaning of this downward-pointing white triangle with a thick red border and the words 'BERI LALUAN'?
question_ms: Apakah maksud papan tanda segi tiga putih terbalik menghala ke bawah dengan sempadan merah tebal dan perkataan 'BERI LALUAN'?
options_en: Warning of hazard ahead
Give Way (Beri Laluan) to traffic on the major road or roundabout
Mandatory ahead only requiring selection of a lower transmission ratio
Accident area stop sign
options_ms: Amaran bahaya di hadapan
Beri laluan kepada kenderaan di jalan utama atau di dalam bulatan
Wajib pandu terus sahaja yang memerlukan pemilihan nisbah gear yang lebih rendah
Tanda berhenti kawasan kemalangan
explanation_en: Give Way (Beri Laluan) to traffic on the major road or roundabout. Recommended action: Slow down and be prepared to stop behind the double dashed line if any vehicle is approaching on the priority road.
explanation_ms: Beri laluan kepada kenderaan di jalan utama atau di dalam bulatan. Tindakan disyorkan: Perlahankan kenderaan dan bersedia berhenti di belakang garisan putus-putus berkembar jika ada kenderaan di jalan utama.

question_en: What does this circular handheld sign reading 'BERHENTI KANAK-KANAK MELINTAS' displayed between 6:00 a.m. and 7:00 p.m. require?
question_ms: Apakah tuntutan tanda bulatan bertulis 'BERHENTI KANAK-KANAK MELINTAS' yang ditunjukkan oleh pengawal lintasan antara jam 6:00 pagi hingga 7:00 malam?
options_en: School bus parking zone only on high-volume single carriageway trunk routes located within 100 metres before the main roadway junction
Playground open 6 a.m. to 7 p.m.
Stop — School children crossing (held by school warden between 6:00 a.m. and 7:00 p.m.)
Warning of school 500 metres ahead
options_ms: Zon parkir bas sekolah sahaja di laluan jalan raya tunggal dengan aliran trafik yang tinggi dalam jarak 100 meter sebelum tiba di persimpangan jalan
Taman permainan dibuka 6 pagi hingga 7 malam
Berhenti — Kanak-kanak melintas (dipegang oleh pengawal lintasan sekolah antara 6:00 pagi hingga 7:00 malam)
Amaran sekolah 500 meter di hadapan
explanation_en: Stop — School children crossing (held by school warden between 6:00 a.m. and 7:00 p.m.). Recommended action: Stop immediately before the crossing and remain stationary until the warden lowers the sign and all children have crossed.
explanation_ms: Berhenti — Kanak-kanak melintas (dipegang oleh pengawal lintasan sekolah antara 6:00 pagi hingga 7:00 malam). Tindakan disyorkan: Berhenti serta-merta sebelum lintasan dan tunggu sehingga pengawal menurunkan tanda serta semua murid selesai melintas.

question_en: What does this red-bordered triangular sign reading 'BERHENTI KEMALANGAN' placed on the road by police indicate?
question_ms: Apakah maksud tanda segi tiga bersempadan merah bertulis 'BERHENTI KEMALANGAN' yang diletakkan di jalan raya oleh pihak polis?
options_en: High-accident blackspot warning sign
Hospital emergency room entrance
Breakdown tow-truck station located within 100 metres before the main roadway junction
Stop — Accident Area (Berhenti Kawasan Kemalangan) placed by police at a crash scene
options_ms: Tanda amaran kawasan kerap kemalangan
Laluan masuk kecemasan hospital
Stesen trak tunda kerosakan dalam jarak 100 meter sebelum tiba di persimpangan jalan
Berhenti — Kawasan Kemalangan yang diletakkan oleh pihak polis di lokasi nahas
explanation_en: Stop — Accident Area (Berhenti Kawasan Kemalangan) placed by police at a crash scene. Recommended action: Stop as directed, obey police traffic control, and do not obstruct emergency rescue vehicles.
explanation_ms: Berhenti — Kawasan Kemalangan yang diletakkan oleh pihak polis di lokasi nahas. Tindakan disyorkan: Berhenti seperti diarahkan, patuhi kawalan trafik polis, dan jangan menghalang kenderaan penyelamat.

question_en: What restriction is imposed by this red-bordered white circular sign displaying the black number '30'?

Minimum speed of 30 km/h
Distance of 30 km to next town
Weight limit of 30 tonnes

Kelajuan minimum 30 km/j

Had berat muatan 30 tan
explanation_en: Maximum speed limit of 30 km/h (commonly enforced in school zones and residential areas). Recommended action: Ensure your speedometer never exceeds 30 km/h while driving within this restricted zone.
explanation_ms: Had laju maksimum 30 km/j (biasanya dikuatkuasakan di zon sekolah dan kawasan perumahan). Tindakan disyorkan: Pastikan meter kelajuan kenderaan anda tidak melebihi 30 km/j sepanjang berada di zon ini.

question_en: What restriction is imposed by this red-bordered white circular sign displaying the black number '50'?
question_ms: Apakah sekatan yang dikuatkuasakan oleh tanda bulatan putih bersempadan merah yang memaparkan angka hitam '50' ini?

Federal Route 50 marker

50 meter ke garisan berhenti

explanation_ms: Had laju maksimum 50 km/j. Tindakan disyorkan: Pandu pada atau di bawah kelajuan 50 km/j, dan perlahankan lagi jika keadaan trafik atau cuaca memerlukan.

question_en: What restriction is imposed by this red-bordered white circular sign displaying the black number '60'?
question_ms: Apakah sekatan yang dikuatkuasakan oleh tanda bulatan putih bersempadan merah yang memaparkan angka hitam '60' ini?

Minimum speed of 60 km/h requiring steady deceleration before reaching the zone

explanation_en: Maximum speed limit of 60 km/h (standard urban town road limit). Recommended action: Do not exceed 60 km/h until you pass a new speed limit or an End of Speed Limit sign.
explanation_ms: Had laju maksimum 60 km/j (had laju kawasan bandar). Tindakan disyorkan: Jangan melebihi kelajuan 60 km/j sehingga melepasi tanda had laju baharu atau tanda Had Laju Berakhir.

question_en: What restriction is imposed by this red-bordered white circular sign displaying the black number '80'?

Perisai lebuh raya Laluan 80

explanation_en: Maximum speed limit of 80 km/h (often enforced on federal roads during festive Ops Bersepadu). Recommended action: Keep your vehicle speed at or below 80 km/h.
explanation_ms: Had laju maksimum 80 km/j (sering dikuatkuasakan di jalan persekutuan semasa musim perayaan). Tindakan disyorkan: Kekalkan kelajuan kenderaan anda pada atau di bawah 80 km/j.

question_en: What restriction is imposed by this red-bordered white circular sign displaying the black number '90'?
question_ms: Apakah sekatan yang dikuatkuasakan oleh tanda bulatan putih bersempadan merah yang memaparkan angka hitam '90' ini?

Had laju minimum di lorong kanan
Syarat bunga tayar 90%

explanation_ms: Had laju maksimum 90 km/j (had laju kebangsaan di jalan persekutuan dan negeri). Tindakan disyorkan: Pandu tidak melebihi 90 km/j apabila keadaan jalan jelas dan kering.

question_en: What restriction is imposed by this red-bordered white circular sign displaying the black number '110'?
question_ms: Apakah sekatan yang dikuatkuasakan oleh tanda bulatan putih bersempadan merah yang memaparkan angka hitam '110' ini?

Had laju bagi kenderaan barangan berat
Jarak ke plaza tol 110 m

explanation_ms: Had laju maksimum 110 km/j (had laju kebangsaan di lebuh raya Malaysia). Tindakan disyorkan: Jangan sesekali melebihi 110 km/j di lebuh raya walaupun ketika memotong di lorong kanan.

question_en: What does this white circular sign with a black border and three parallel diagonal black lines across the face indicate?
question_ms: Apakah maksud tanda bulatan putih bersempadan hitam dengan tiga garisan serong hitam selari merentasi permukaannya?

Road closed to all vehicles
End of localized speed limit (Had Laju Berakhir)
National speed limit is unlimited on high-volume single carriageway trunk routes

Jalan ditutup kepada semua kenderaan

Tiada sebarang had laju kebangsaan di laluan jalan raya tunggal dengan aliran trafik yang tinggi
explanation_en: End of localized speed limit (Had Laju Berakhir). Recommended action: The previous localized speed restriction ends here; normal statutory road speed limits now apply.
explanation_ms: Had laju tempatan berakhir (Had Laju Berakhir). Tindakan disyorkan: Had laju tempatan sebelum ini berakhir di sini; had laju kebangsaan mengikut jenis jalan kini terpakai.

question_en: What does this red-bordered circular sign with inward-pointing horizontal triangles on the left and right of '2.5 m' prohibit?
question_ms: Apakah larangan tanda bulatan bersempadan merah yang mempunyai segi tiga melintang di kiri dan kanan angka '2.5 m' ini?
options_en: Minimum lane width is 2.5 metres
Keep a 2.5-metre gap between cars located within 100 metres before the main roadway junction
Vehicles over 2.5 metres high prohibited
Vehicles exceeding 2.5 metres in overall width are prohibited from entering

Kekalkan jarak 2.5 meter antara kereta dalam jarak 100 meter sebelum tiba di persimpangan jalan
Kenderaan melebihi tinggi 2.5 meter dilarang masuk
Kenderaan melebihi lebar 2.5 meter dilarang masuk

explanation_ms: Kenderaan melebihi lebar 2.5 meter dilarang masuk. Tindakan disyorkan: Pemandu kenderaan lebar yang melebihi 2.5 meter mesti menggunakan laluan alternatif.

question_en: What does this red-bordered circular sign with inward-pointing vertical triangles at the top and bottom of '3.5 m' prohibit?

Kenderaan melebihi lebar 3.5 meter dilarang masuk
Kedalaman air mencecah 3.5 meter
Panjang jambatan ialah 3.5 meter
explanation_en: Vehicles exceeding 3.5 metres in height are prohibited from entering (overhead bridge/tunnel clearance). Recommended action: Ensure your vehicle and its load are under 3.5 metres high before passing beneath the structure.
explanation_ms: Kenderaan melebihi tinggi 3.5 meter dilarang masuk (kelegaan jambatan atau terowong di atas). Tindakan disyorkan: Pastikan ketinggian kenderaan dan muatannya tidak melebihi 3.5 meter sebelum melalui bawah struktur tersebut.

Kenderaan melebihi berat muatan 8 tan dilarang masuk
Kadar tol 8 tan dikenakan di hadapan di mana aliran trafik bertentangan diberi keutamaan jalan

explanation_ms: Kenderaan melebihi berat muatan 8 tan dilarang masuk. Tindakan disyorkan: Kenderaan berat yang melebihi muatan 8 tan dilarang melalui jalan atau jambatan ini.

question_en: What does this red-bordered circular sign depicting a goods lorry silhouette crossed by a red diagonal slash mean?
question_ms: Apakah maksud tanda bulatan bersempadan merah yang memaparkan bayang hitam sebuah lori dipalang dengan garisan merah?

question_en: What does this red-bordered circular sign depicting a walking figure crossed by a red diagonal slash prohibit?
question_ms: Apakah larangan tanda bulatan bersempadan merah yang memaparkan simbol pejalan kaki dipalang dengan garisan merah?

School children crossing ahead with a continuous central dividing median barrier

Zon pejalan kaki sahaja
Kanak-kanak sekolah melintas di hadapan dengan pembahagi jalan konkrit berterusan di hadapan
Pejalan kaki dilarang melintas atau berjalan di laluan ini

explanation_ms: Pejalan kaki dilarang melintas atau berjalan di laluan ini. Tindakan disyorkan: Pejalan kaki mesti menggunakan jejantas, terowong bawah atau laluan pejalan kaki yang disediakan.

question_en: What does this rectangular blue sign with a large white upward arrow and the words 'JALAN SEHALA' indicate?
question_ms: Apakah maksud papan tanda segi empat tepat berwarna biru dengan anak panah putih besar ke atas dan perkataan 'JALAN SEHALA'?

Lorong memotong di hadapan
Laluan lebuh raya arah utara
explanation_en: One-Way Street (Jalan Sehala) — all traffic must travel in the direction of the white arrow. Recommended action: Drive only in the arrow's direction and never reverse or turn around against the one-way flow.
explanation_ms: Jalan Sehala — semua kenderaan mesti bergerak mengikut arah anak panah putih. Tindakan disyorkan: Pandu hanya mengikut arah anak panah dan jangan sesekali mengundur atau berpusing lawan arus.

question_en: What compulsory instruction is given by this blue circular sign with a single white arrow pointing straight up?
question_ms: Apakah arahan wajib yang diberikan oleh tanda bulatan biru dengan satu anak panah putih menghala lurus ke atas ini?

Priority over oncoming vehicles requiring selection of a lower transmission ratio
options_ms: Jalan sehala berakhir di hadapan

Keutamaan berbanding kenderaan bertentangan

explanation_ms: Arahan mandatori: Pandu terus sahaja. Tindakan disyorkan: Anda wajib memandu terus di persimpangan ini; membelok ke kiri, kanan atau membuat pusingan U adalah dilarang.

question_en: What compulsory instruction is given by this blue circular sign with a horizontal white arrow pointing to the left?
question_ms: Apakah arahan wajib yang diberikan oleh tanda bulatan biru dengan anak panah putih melintang menghala ke sebelah kiri ini?

Dilarang belok kiri di laluan jalan raya tunggal dengan aliran trafik yang tinggi
Arahan mandatori: Belok kiri sahaja
Ikut kiri pulau jalan

explanation_ms: Arahan mandatori: Belok kiri sahaja. Tindakan disyorkan: Beri lampu isyarat kiri dan belok ke kiri di persimpangan ini.

question_en: What compulsory instruction is given by this blue circular sign with a horizontal white arrow pointing to the right?
question_ms: Apakah arahan wajib yang diberikan oleh tanda bulatan biru dengan anak panah putih melintang menghala ke sebelah kanan ini?

explanation_ms: Arahan mandatori: Belok kanan sahaja. Tindakan disyorkan: Beri lampu isyarat kanan dan belok ke kanan di persimpangan ini.

question_en: What compulsory instruction is given by this blue circular sign with a vertical white stem curving 90 degrees to the left at the top?
question_ms: Apakah arahan wajib yang diberikan oleh tanda bulatan biru dengan anak panah putih menegak yang melengkung ke kiri di bahagian atas?

Side road on the left warning
No left turn ahead
U-turn lane on the left

Lorong pusingan U di sebelah kiri

explanation_ms: Arahan mandatori: Belok kiri di hadapan. Tindakan disyorkan: Masuk ke lorong kiri, beri isyarat kiri, dan ikut selekoh belok kiri wajib di hadapan.

question_en: What compulsory instruction is given by this blue circular sign with a vertical white stem curving 90 degrees to the right at the top?
question_ms: Apakah arahan wajib yang diberikan oleh tanda bulatan biru dengan anak panah putih menegak yang melengkung ke kanan di bahagian atas?
options_en: Side road on the right warning where oncoming traffic has priority of movement

Roundabout ahead

Bulatan di hadapan

question_en: According to the KPP03 stopping distance chart, once the brake pedal is applied at 20 km/h on a dry road, what is the BRAKING distance (Jarak Brek) needed to halt?
question_ms: Berdasarkan jadual jarak berhenti KPP03, sebaik sahaja pedal brek ditekan pada kelajuan 20 km/j di jalan kering, berapakah JARAK BREK yang diperlukan untuk berhenti?
options_en: 6 metres within designated municipal urban speed restriction zones when approaching busy pedestrian priority crossing areas
24 metres
2 metres
3 metres (giving a total stopping distance of 9 m after adding 6 m reaction distance)
options_ms: 6 meter di dalam zon had laju bandar pihak berkuasa tempatan apabila menghampiri persimpangan sibuk atau lintasan pejalan kaki
24 meter
2 meter
3 meter (menjadikan jumlah jarak berhenti 9 m selepas ditambah 6 m jarak tindak balas)
explanation_en: At 20 km/h on a dry road, the braking distance after the pedal is depressed is 3 m (plus 6 m reaction = 9 m total).
explanation_ms: Pada kelajuan 20 km/j di jalan kering, jarak brek selepas pedal ditekan ialah 3 m (ditambah 6 m tindak balas = 9 m jumlah).

question_en: A driver is travelling at 20 km/h on a residential courtyard or car park when a hazard appears 5 metres ahead. Based on the dry stopping distance of 9 m, what will happen on a wet road?
question_ms: Seorang pemandu memandu pada kelajuan 20 km/j apabila satu bahaya muncul 5 meter di hadapan. Berdasarkan jarak berhenti jalan kering 9 m (6 m tindak balas + 3 m brek), apakah yang akan berlaku jika jalan basah?
options_en: The vehicle cannot stop in time because wet surfaces approximately double the 3 m braking distance well beyond 9 m
The vehicle will stop in 6 m because water cools the tyres
Reaction distance drops to 0 m in the rain when approaching busy pedestrian priority crossing areas provided hazard warning lights are activated beforehand
Braking distance is cut in half on wet asphalt
options_ms: Kenderaan tidak sempat berhenti kerana permukaan jalan basah menggandakan jarak brek 3 m jauh melebihi 9 m
Kenderaan akan berhenti dalam 6 m kerana air menyejukkan tayar
Jarak tindak balas menjadi 0 m semasa hujan apabila menghampiri persimpangan sibuk atau lintasan pejalan kaki
Jarak brek berkurang separuh di atas tar basah
explanation_en: Even on a dry road 20 km/h requires 9 m to stop; on a wet road braking distance roughly doubles, making a collision unavoidable at 5 m.
explanation_ms: Walaupun di jalan kering 20 km/j memerlukan 9 m untuk berhenti; di jalan basah jarak brek berganda, menjadikan perlanggaran tidak dapat dielakkan pada jarak 5 m.

question_en: According to the KPP03 stopping distance chart, how many metres does a vehicle travel during the driver's REACTION time alone when cruising at 30 km/h?
question_ms: Berdasarkan jadual jarak berhenti KPP03, berapakah jarak (dalam meter) yang dilalui oleh kenderaan semasa MASA TINDAK BALAS pemandu sahaja pada kelajuan 30 km/j?
options_en: 6 metres provided hazard warning lights are activated beforehand
9 metres (before the brakes even begin to slow the wheels)
15 metres
21 metres
options_ms: 6 meter dengan syarat lampu amaran kecemasan dinyalakan terlebih dahulu
9 meter (sebelum brek mula memperlahankan roda)
15 meter
21 meter
explanation_en: At 30 km/h, the vehicle covers 9 m during reaction time and 6 m during braking, totalling 15 m.
explanation_ms: Pada kelajuan 30 km/j, kenderaan bergerak sejauh 9 m semasa masa tindak balas dan 6 m semasa membrek, menjadikan jumlah 15 m.

question_en: According to the KPP03 stopping distance chart, once the brake pedal is applied at 30 km/h on a dry road, what is the BRAKING distance (Jarak Brek) needed to halt?
question_ms: Berdasarkan jadual jarak berhenti KPP03, sebaik sahaja pedal brek ditekan pada kelajuan 30 km/j di jalan kering, berapakah JARAK BREK yang diperlukan untuk berhenti?
options_en: 9 metres
30 metres
6 metres (giving a total stopping distance of 15 m after adding 9 m reaction distance)
2 metres
options_ms: 9 meter
30 meter
6 meter (menjadikan jumlah jarak berhenti 15 m selepas ditambah 9 m jarak tindak balas)
2 meter
explanation_en: At 30 km/h on a dry road, the braking distance after the pedal is depressed is 6 m (plus 9 m reaction = 15 m total).
explanation_ms: Pada kelajuan 30 km/j di jalan kering, jarak brek selepas pedal ditekan ialah 6 m (ditambah 9 m tindak balas = 15 m jumlah).

question_en: A driver is travelling at 30 km/h on a school zone when a hazard appears 11 metres ahead. Based on the dry stopping distance of 15 m, what will happen on a wet road?
question_ms: Seorang pemandu memandu pada kelajuan 30 km/j apabila satu bahaya muncul 11 meter di hadapan. Berdasarkan jarak berhenti jalan kering 15 m (9 m tindak balas + 6 m brek), apakah yang akan berlaku jika jalan basah?

Reaction distance drops to 0 m in the rain provided the forward roadway is completely unobstructed while maintaining at least a 2-second safe trailing interval
Braking distance is cut in half on wet asphalt
The vehicle cannot stop in time because wet surfaces approximately double the 6 m braking distance well beyond 15 m
options_ms: Kenderaan akan berhenti dalam 9 m kerana air menyejukkan tayar
Jarak tindak balas menjadi 0 m semasa hujan dengan syarat laluan hadapan lapang daripada sebarang trafik sambil mengekalkan jarak mengekor selamat sekurang-kurangnya 2 saat

Kenderaan tidak sempat berhenti kerana permukaan jalan basah menggandakan jarak brek 6 m jauh melebihi 15 m
explanation_en: Even on a dry road 30 km/h requires 15 m to stop; on a wet road braking distance roughly doubles, making a collision unavoidable at 11 m.
explanation_ms: Walaupun di jalan kering 30 km/j memerlukan 15 m untuk berhenti; di jalan basah jarak brek berganda, menjadikan perlanggaran tidak dapat dielakkan pada jarak 11 m.

explanation_ms: Kesalahan memandu secara berterusan di lorong kanan (lorong memotong) di lebuh raya tanpa memotong membawa: Kesalahan gagal mematuhi peraturan Ikut Kiri Kecuali Memotong dengan kompaun sehingga RM300.

question_en: According to the KPP01 Schedule of Offences, what is the legal classification and penalty for reversing a motor vehicle for an unreasonable distance or reversing on an expressway mainline?
question_ms: Berdasarkan Jadual Kesalahan KPP01, apakah klasifikasi undang-undang dan hukuman bagi kesalahan mengundurkan kenderaan pada jarak yang tidak munasabah atau mengundur di lorong utama lebuh raya?
options_en: Dangerous traffic offence carrying up to a RM300 compound
No penalty is imposed unless an accident occurs
A RM5 municipal parking coupon only after verifying mirrors and shoulder blind spot clear
Permitted for drivers who have held a CDL for over 5 years
options_ms: Kesalahan lalu lintas berbahaya yang boleh dikenakan kompaun sehingga RM300
Tiada denda dikenakan melainkan berlaku kemalangan
Kupon parkir majlis bernilai RM5 sahaja selepas memeriksa cermin sisi dan titik buta pandangan belakang
Dibenarkan bagi pemandu yang telah memegang CDL melebihi 5 tahun
explanation_en: Reversing a motor vehicle for an unreasonable distance or reversing on an expressway mainline results in: Dangerous traffic offence carrying up to a RM300 compound.
explanation_ms: Kesalahan mengundurkan kenderaan pada jarak yang tidak munasabah atau mengundur di lorong utama lebuh raya membawa: Kesalahan lalu lintas berbahaya yang boleh dikenakan kompaun sehingga RM300.

question_en: According to the KPP01 Schedule of Offences, what is the legal classification and penalty for leaving a broken-down heavy vehicle on a highway without placing a reflective warning triangle at least 45 metres behind it?
question_ms: Berdasarkan Jadual Kesalahan KPP01, apakah klasifikasi undang-undang dan hukuman bagi kesalahan meninggalkan kenderaan yang rosak di jalan raya tanpa meletakkan segi tiga amaran pemantul cahaya di belakangnya?
options_en: No penalty is imposed unless an accident occurs
A RM5 municipal parking coupon only
Permitted for drivers who have held a CDL for over 5 years
Offence under the Construction and Use Rules carrying up to a RM300 compound
options_ms: Tiada denda dikenakan melainkan berlaku kemalangan
Kupon parkir majlis bernilai RM5 sahaja
Dibenarkan bagi pemandu yang telah memegang CDL melebihi 5 tahun
Kesalahan di bawah Kaedah Pembinaan dan Penggunaan yang membawa kompaun sehingga RM300
explanation_en: Leaving a broken-down heavy vehicle on a highway without placing a reflective warning triangle at least 45 metres behind it results in: Offence under the Construction and Use Rules carrying up to a RM300 compound.
explanation_ms: Kesalahan meninggalkan kenderaan yang rosak di jalan raya tanpa meletakkan segi tiga amaran pemantul cahaya di belakangnya membawa: Kesalahan di bawah Kaedah Pembinaan dan Penggunaan yang membawa kompaun sehingga RM300.

question_en: According to the KPP01 Schedule of Offences, what is the legal classification and penalty for overloading a passenger vehicle beyond its permitted seating capacity?
question_ms: Berdasarkan Jadual Kesalahan KPP01, apakah klasifikasi undang-undang dan hukuman bagi kesalahan membawa penumpang berlebihan melebihi kapasiti tempat duduk yang dibenarkan?
options_en: No penalty is imposed unless an accident occurs
A RM5 municipal parking coupon only
Offence under the Road Transport Act carrying a compound fine up to RM300
Permitted for drivers who have held a CDL for over 5 years within designated municipal urban speed restriction zones
options_ms: Tiada denda dikenakan melainkan berlaku kemalangan
Kupon parkir majlis bernilai RM5 sahaja
Kesalahan di bawah Akta Pengangkutan Jalan yang membawa kompaun sehingga RM300
Dibenarkan bagi pemandu yang telah memegang CDL melebihi 5 tahun di dalam zon had laju bandar pihak berkuasa tempatan
explanation_en: Overloading a passenger vehicle beyond its permitted seating capacity results in: Offence under the Road Transport Act carrying a compound fine up to RM300.
explanation_ms: Kesalahan membawa penumpang berlebihan melebihi kapasiti tempat duduk yang dibenarkan membawa: Kesalahan di bawah Akta Pengangkutan Jalan yang membawa kompaun sehingga RM300.

question_en: According to the KPP01 Schedule of Offences, what is the legal classification and penalty for emitting excessive black smoke from a vehicle exhaust exceeding the DOE/JPJ Hartridge Smoke Unit limit?
question_ms: Berdasarkan Jadual Kesalahan KPP01, apakah klasifikasi undang-undang dan hukuman bagi kesalahan mengeluarkan asap hitam berlebihan daripada ekzos kenderaan melebihi had yang ditetapkan oleh JAS/JPJ?
options_en: Environmental and Construction & Use offence carrying up to a RM300 compound
No penalty is imposed unless an accident occurs
A RM5 municipal parking coupon only when approaching busy pedestrian priority crossing areas
Permitted for drivers who have held a CDL for over 5 years
options_ms: Kesalahan alam sekitar dan Kaedah Pembinaan & Penggunaan dengan kompaun sehingga RM300
Tiada denda dikenakan melainkan berlaku kemalangan
Kupon parkir majlis bernilai RM5 sahaja apabila menghampiri persimpangan sibuk atau lintasan pejalan kaki
Dibenarkan bagi pemandu yang telah memegang CDL melebihi 5 tahun
explanation_en: Emitting excessive black smoke from a vehicle exhaust exceeding the DOE/JPJ Hartridge Smoke Unit limit results in: Environmental and Construction & Use offence carrying up to a RM300 compound.
explanation_ms: Kesalahan mengeluarkan asap hitam berlebihan daripada ekzos kenderaan melebihi had yang ditetapkan oleh JAS/JPJ membawa: Kesalahan alam sekitar dan Kaedah Pembinaan & Penggunaan dengan kompaun sehingga RM300.

question_en: According to the KPP01 Schedule of Offences, what is the legal classification and penalty for throwing rubbish, cigarette butts, or objects out of a moving vehicle onto a public road?
question_ms: Berdasarkan Jadual Kesalahan KPP01, apakah klasifikasi undang-undang dan hukuman bagi kesalahan membuang sampah, puntung rokok atau objek keluar dari kenderaan ke atas jalan raya awam?
options_en: No penalty is imposed unless an accident occurs
A RM5 municipal parking coupon only provided hazard warning lights are activated beforehand
Offence under the Road Traffic Rules punishable by a compound fine up to RM300
Permitted for drivers who have held a CDL for over 5 years
options_ms: Tiada denda dikenakan melainkan berlaku kemalangan
Kupon parkir majlis bernilai RM5 sahaja dengan syarat lampu amaran kecemasan dinyalakan terlebih dahulu
Kesalahan di bawah Kaedah-Kaedah Lalu Lintas Jalan yang membawa kompaun sehingga RM300
Dibenarkan bagi pemandu yang telah memegang CDL melebihi 5 tahun
explanation_en: Throwing rubbish, cigarette butts, or objects out of a moving vehicle onto a public road results in: Offence under the Road Traffic Rules punishable by a compound fine up to RM300.
explanation_ms: Kesalahan membuang sampah, puntung rokok atau objek keluar dari kenderaan ke atas jalan raya awam membawa: Kesalahan di bawah Kaedah-Kaedah Lalu Lintas Jalan yang membawa kompaun sehingga RM300.

question_en: You are approaching a 2-lane roundabout in the left lane intending to take the first exit (9 o'clock). When should you switch on your left indicator?
question_ms: Anda menghampiri bulatan 2 lorong di lorong kiri dan ingin keluar di susur pertama (arah pukul 9). Bilakah anda perlu memasang lampu isyarat kiri?
options_en: Only after you have exited the roundabout
Switch on the right indicator while turning left
Do not use any indicator when taking the first exit
Before entering the roundabout, and keep it flashing until you have exited at the 9 o'clock road
options_ms: Hanya selepas anda keluar sepenuhnya dari bulatan
Pasang lampu isyarat kanan semasa membelok ke kiri
Jangan gunakan sebarang lampu isyarat apabila keluar di simpang pertama
Sebelum memasuki bulatan, dan biarkan ia terus berkelip sehingga anda selesai keluar di simpang pukul 9
explanation_en: For a 9 o'clock left exit at a roundabout, signal left on approach and maintain the left signal through the exit.
explanation_ms: Bagi susur keluar pertama (pukul 9) di bulatan, beri isyarat kiri sebelum masuk dan kekalkan sehingga keluar.

question_en: Why must you NOT switch on your left indicator before entering a roundabout when your intention is to go straight ahead to the 12 o'clock exit?
question_ms: Mengapakah anda DILARANG memasang lampu isyarat kiri sebelum memasuki bulatan sekiranya anda mahu bergerak terus ke susur keluar pukul 12?
options_en: Because the left indicator bulb overheats inside roundabouts provided the forward roadway is completely unobstructed while maintaining at least a 2-second safe trailing interval
Because going straight requires the hazard warning lights
Drivers waiting at the first entrance (9 o'clock) will mistakenly believe you are exiting early and may pull out into your path
Because left signals are only legal on tolled expressways
options_ms: Kerana mentol lampu isyarat kiri cepat panas di dalam bulatan dengan syarat laluan hadapan lapang daripada sebarang trafik sambil mengekalkan jarak mengekor selamat sekurang-kurangnya 2 saat
Kerana bergerak terus memerlukan lampu kecemasan dipasang
Pemandu yang menunggu di simpang pertama (pukul 9) akan menyangka anda mahu keluar di simpang mereka lalu keluar melintasi laluan anda
Kerana isyarat kiri hanya sah di atas lebuh raya bertol
explanation_en: Signalling left only after passing the 9 o'clock exit prevents false signals to waiting traffic at the first junction.
explanation_ms: Memberi isyarat kiri hanya selepas melepasi simpang pukul 9 mengelakkan kekeliruan kepada pemandu yang menunggu di simpang pertama.

question_en: On a 3-lane roundabout, you want to make a U-turn (6 o'clock exit) back in the direction you came from. Which lane and signal sequence is correct?
question_ms: Pada bulatan 3 lorong, anda ingin berpatah balik (susur keluar pukul 6). Apakah turutan lorong dan lampu isyarat yang betul?
options_en: Enter from the outer left lane and circle past all three exits without signalling

Enter from the middle lane with hazard lights on while maintaining at least a 2-second safe trailing interval after verifying mirrors and shoulder blind spot clear during clear daylight hours on dry tarmac carriageways
Enter from the extreme RIGHT lane signalling right, stay in the innermost right lane past the 9, 12, and 3 o'clock exits, then signal left and check your left mirror/blind spot to exit
Make a U-turn across the approach divider before reaching the roundabout
options_ms: Masuk dari lorong paling kiri dan pusing melepasi ketiga-tiga simpang tanpa isyarat

Masuk dari lorong tengah sambil memasang lampu kecemasan sambil mengekalkan jarak mengekor selamat sekurang-kurangnya 2 saat selepas memeriksa cermin sisi dan titik buta pandangan belakang semasa waktu siang cerah pada permukaan jalan berturap kering
Masuk dari lorong paling KANAN dengan isyarat kanan, kekal di lorong paling dalam melepasi susur pukul 9, 12 dan 3, kemudian beri isyarat kiri serta periksa cermin/titik buta kiri untuk keluar
Buat pusingan U merentasi pembahagi jalan sebelum tiba di bulatan
explanation_en: Full U-turns (6 o'clock) at a 3-lane roundabout use the innermost right lane with a right signal until passing the 3 o'clock exit, followed by a left signal to exit.
explanation_ms: Pusingan balik (pukul 6) di bulatan 3 lorong menggunakan lorong paling kanan dengan isyarat kanan sehingga melepasi susur pukul 3, diikuti isyarat kiri untuk keluar.

question_en: While circulating in the inner right lane of a roundabout to exit at 3 o'clock, what hazard must you check for before moving across to the exit?
question_ms: Semasa beredar di lorong dalam (kanan) bulatan untuk keluar di susur pukul 3, apakah bahaya utama yang mesti diperiksa sebelum membelok keluar?
options_en: Check only the interior roof light
Check your left side mirror and left blind spot for vehicles or motorcycles continuing around the outer left lane
Look only at the vehicle directly behind you in the inner lane after verifying mirrors and shoulder blind spot clear
Close both side mirrors to reduce wind drag
options_ms: Periksa lampu siling dalaman sahaja
Periksa cermin sisi kiri dan titik buta sebelah kiri bagi mengesan kenderaan atau motosikal yang sedang bergerak di lorong luar (kiri)
Lihat hanya kenderaan betul-betul di belakang anda di lorong dalam selepas memeriksa cermin sisi dan titik buta pandangan belakang semasa waktu siang cerah pada permukaan jalan berturap kering
Lipat kedua-dua cermin sisi untuk mengurangkan rintangan angin
explanation_en: Motorcycles and cars in the outer lane often lie in your left blind spot as you exit from the inner lane of a roundabout.
explanation_ms: Motosikal dan kereta di lorong luar sering berada di titik buta kiri anda semasa anda hendak keluar dari lorong dalam bulatan.

question_en: What is the correct procedure if you accidentally miss your intended exit at a roundabout?
question_ms: Apakah tindakan yang betul sekiranya anda terlepas susur keluar yang ingin dituju semasa berada di dalam bulatan?
options_en: Continue circulating calmly around the roundabout for another full loop in a safe lane until you return to your exit — never stop or reverse
Stop immediately and reverse backward against the roundabout flow
Swerve sharply across three lanes without checking mirrors
Park on the central roundabout grass island and call a tow truck
options_ms: Teruskan memandu mengelilingi bulatan sekali lagi dengan tenang sehingga tiba semula di susur keluar tersebut — jangan sesekali berhenti atau mengundur
Berhenti serta-merta dan mengundur melawan arus bulatan
Memotong secara mengejut merentasi tiga lorong tanpa memeriksa cermin
Parkir di atas pulau rumput tengah bulatan dan hubungi trak tunda
explanation_en: If you miss your exit in a roundabout, simply complete another clockwise circuit and exit safely on the next pass.
explanation_ms: Jika terlepas susur keluar di bulatan, teruskan pusingan mengelilingi bulatan sekali lagi dan keluar dengan selamat.

question_en: What is the correct procedure if you accidentally miss your exit (Susur Keluar) on a tolled expressway?
question_ms: Apakah tindakan yang betul sekiranya anda terlepas susur keluar (Exit) semasa memandu di lebuh raya bertol?
options_en: Stop in the emergency lane and reverse slowly back to the slip road
Make a U-turn across the grass median divider within designated municipal urban speed restriction zones when approaching busy pedestrian priority crossing areas
Continue driving forward to the next interchange exit — NEVER stop on the chevron gore or reverse along the emergency lane
Reverse in the rightmost overtaking lane with hazard lights on
options_ms: Berhenti di lorong kecemasan dan mengundur perlahan-lahan ke susur keluar tadi
Buat pusingan U merentasi pembahagi jalan berumput di dalam zon had laju bandar pihak berkuasa tempatan apabila menghampiri persimpangan sibuk atau lintasan pejalan kaki
Teruskan pemanduan ke susur keluar persimpangan yang seterusnya — JANGAN sesekali berhenti di garisan chevron atau mengundur di lorong kecemasan
Mengundur di lorong memotong paling kanan sambil memasang lampu kecemasan
explanation_en: Reversing or stopping at an expressway exit gore is a lethal hazard and a serious offence; always proceed to the next exit.
explanation_ms: Mengundur atau berhenti di susur keluar lebuh raya amat berbahaya dan merupakan kesalahan berat; teruskan ke susur keluar seterusnya.

question_en: On a three-lane dual carriageway or expressway (Lebuh Raya 3 Lorong), what is the designated function of each lane from left to right?
question_ms: Pada lebuh raya kembar tiga lorong, apakah fungsi yang ditetapkan bagi setiap lorong dari kiri ke kanan?
options_en: Left lane: parking only; Middle lane: heavy lorries only; Right lane: motorcycles only
Left lane: overtaking; Middle lane: emergency stopping; Right lane: slow vehicles
Left lane: normal cruising & slower/heavy vehicles; Middle lane: overtaking slower left-lane traffic & steady cruising; Right lane: overtaking only before returning to the middle/left lane

All three lanes may be used for overtaking simultaneously from either side when approaching busy pedestrian priority crossing areas provided hazard warning lights are activated beforehand unless directed otherwise by an authorised traffic officer
options_ms: Lorong kiri: parkir sahaja; Lorong tengah: lori berat sahaja; Lorong kanan: motosikal sahaja
Lorong kiri: memotong; Lorong tengah: berhenti kecemasan; Lorong kanan: kenderaan perlahan
Lorong kiri: pemanduan biasa & kenderaan perlahan/berat; Lorong tengah: memotong kenderaan di lorong kiri; Lorong kanan: memotong sahaja sebelum kembali ke lorong kiri/tengah

Ketiga-tiga lorong bebas digunakan untuk memotong serentak dari mana-mana arah apabila menghampiri persimpangan sibuk atau lintasan pejalan kaki dengan syarat lampu amaran kecemasan dinyalakan terlebih dahulu
explanation_en: On a 3-lane highway, the right lane is strictly for overtaking; drivers must not hog the right lane once they have completed passing.
explanation_ms: Di lebuh raya 3 lorong, lorong paling kanan adalah khusus untuk memotong sahaja; pemandu tidak boleh kekal memandu di lorong kanan selepas selesai memotong.

question_en: When exiting an expressway via a deceleration lane (Lorong Nyahpecutan), when should you begin braking to slow down?
question_ms: Apabila keluar dari lebuh raya melalui lorong nyahpecutan (susur keluar), bilakah anda patut mula membrek untuk memperlahankan kenderaan?
options_en: Brake hard from 110 km/h to 30 km/h while still in the rightmost overtaking lane
Signal left early, move into the deceleration slip lane first, and then brake progressively once inside the deceleration lane
Never brake on the exit ramp; coast in Neutral instead
Stop completely on the main expressway before turning into the slip road provided hazard warning lights are activated beforehand
options_ms: Brek mengejut daripada 110 km/j kepada 30 km/j semasa masih di lorong memotong kanan
Beri isyarat kiri lebih awal, masuk ke lorong nyahpecutan terlebih dahulu, dan kemudian barulah membrek secara beransur-ansur selepas berada di dalam lorong susur tersebut
Jangan brek langsung di susur keluar; luncur dalam gear Neutral sahaja
Berhenti sepenuhnya di lorong utama lebuh raya sebelum masuk ke susur dengan syarat lampu amaran kecemasan dinyalakan terlebih dahulu melainkan diarahkan sebaliknya oleh pegawai trafik yang bertugas
explanation_en: Decelerating after entering the dedicated exit slip lane prevents high-speed rear-end collisions on the main expressway carriageway.
explanation_ms: Mengurangkan kelajuan selepas memasuki lorong susur keluar mengelakkan perlanggaran dari belakang oleh trafik laju di lebuh raya utama.

question_en: At a junction with a Green Filter Arrow (Anak Panah Hijau) alongside a red main traffic light, what are drivers in that turning lane allowed to do?
question_ms: Di persimpangan yang mempunyai lampu Anak Panah Hijau menyala bersama lampu utama merah, apakah yang dibenarkan bagi pemandu di lorong membelok tersebut?
options_en: Proceed in any direction including straight ahead through the red light
Proceed cautiously in the direction of the green arrow only, while watching for pedestrians or other road users clearing the junction
Remain stationary until all three lights turn green simultaneously
Make an illegal U-turn from the left slip lane
options_ms: Bergerak ke mana-mana arah termasuk jalan terus walaupun lampu utama merah
Bergerak dengan berhati-hati mengikut arah anak panah hijau tersebut sahaja sambil peka terhadap pejalan kaki atau kenderaan lain di simpang
Kekal berhenti sehingga kesemua lampu bertukar hijau serentak
Membuat pusingan U dari lorong paling kiri
explanation_en: A green filter arrow authorises movement only in the specific direction pointed to by the arrow, provided the path is clear.
explanation_ms: Lampu anak panah hijau membenarkan pergerakan hanya mengikut arah anak panah tersebut dengan syarat laluan adalah selamat.

question_en: When may a vehicle legally enter and wait inside a Yellow Box Junction (Petak Kuning)?
question_ms: Dalam situasi manakah sesebuah kenderaan dibenarkan masuk dan menunggu seketika di dalam Petak Kuning di persimpangan?
options_en: Whenever going straight ahead in heavy bumper-to-bumper congestion
Only when turning RIGHT and prevented from completing the turn solely by oncoming traffic (provided the right exit road itself is completely clear)
When stopping to drop off passengers at a shop beside the junction provided the forward roadway is completely unobstructed while maintaining at least a 2-second safe trailing interval
Whenever the traffic light is about to turn red
options_ms: Apabila bergerak lurus ketika kesesakan jalan raya yang teruk
Hanya apabila hendak membelok ke KANAN dan terhalang semata-mata oleh trafik dari arah bertentangan (dengan syarat jalan keluar di sebelah kanan telah kosong)
Apabila berhenti untuk menurunkan penumpang di tepi simpang dengan syarat laluan hadapan lapang daripada sebarang trafik sambil mengekalkan jarak mengekor selamat sekurang-kurangnya 2 saat
Apabila lampu isyarat hampir bertukar kepada warna merah
explanation_en: Under the Road Traffic Rules, the sole exception for waiting in a yellow box is a right-turning vehicle whose exit road is clear and is only waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic.
explanation_ms: Satu-satunya pengecualian menunggu di dalam petak kuning ialah bagi kenderaan yang hendak membelok ke kanan yang laluannya kosong tetapi sedang menunggu trafik bertentangan.

question_en: What is the rule when two vehicles approach an narrow single-track mountain road on a steep gradient from opposite directions?
question_ms: Apakah peraturan memberi laluan apabila dua kenderaan bertembung dari arah bertentangan di jalan bukit yang sempit?
options_en: The uphill vehicle must reverse all the way down to the bottom of the mountain while maintaining at least a 2-second safe trailing interval after verifying mirrors and shoulder blind spot clear
Both vehicles must accelerate to pass each other on the cliff edge
The vehicle travelling DOWNHILL should give way and pull into a passing bay for the vehicle climbing UPHILL, because restarting a heavy vehicle on a steep uphill slope is much harder
Whoever flashes their headlights first has legal priority
options_ms: Kenderaan yang mendaki wajib mengundur semula sehingga ke kaki bukit sambil mengekalkan jarak mengekor selamat sekurang-kurangnya 2 saat selepas memeriksa cermin sisi dan titik buta pandangan belakang
Kedua-dua kenderaan mesti memecut untuk berselisih di tepi gaung
Kenderaan yang sedang MENURUNI bukit hendaklah memberi laluan kepada kenderaan yang sedang MENDAKI bukit kerana memulakan semula pergerakan mendaki adalah lebih sukar
Sesiapa yang mengelipkan lampu tinggi dahulu mendapat hak laluan
explanation_en: A vehicle climbing a steep gradient has a higher risk of stalling or rolling back if forced to stop; therefore downhill traffic yields where practical.
explanation_ms: Kenderaan yang sedang mendaki bukit curam lebih berisiko mati enjin atau menggelongsor jika terpaksa berhenti; maka kenderaan menuruni bukit patut memberi laluan.

question_en: What does a flashing AMBER traffic light signal at a junction or pedestrian crossing mean?
question_ms: Apakah maksud lampu isyarat KUNING BERKELIP-KELIP di persimpangan atau lintasan pejalan kaki?
options_en: Accelerate to maximum speed before the light turns solid red
Stop permanently and switch off the engine
The road ahead is closed to all motor vehicles after verifying mirrors and shoulder blind spot clear during clear daylight hours on dry tarmac carriageways
Proceed with caution, slow down, and give way to any pedestrians on the crossing or vehicles already in the junction
options_ms: Pecut pada kelajuan maksimum sebelum lampu bertukar merah
Berhenti sepenuhnya dan matikan enjin kenderaan
Jalan di hadapan ditutup kepada semua kenderaan bermotor selepas memeriksa cermin sisi dan titik buta pandangan belakang semasa waktu siang cerah pada permukaan jalan berturap kering
Pandu dengan berhati-hati, perlahankan kenderaan, dan beri laluan kepada pejalan kaki di lintasan atau kenderaan di persimpangan
explanation_en: A flashing amber signal warns drivers to slow down and proceed only with caution after yielding to pedestrians and cross traffic.
explanation_ms: Lampu kuning berkelip memberi amaran supaya memperlahankan kenderaan dan hanya meneruskan perjalanan dengan berhati-hati selepas memberi laluan.

question_en: What does a flashing RED light at a railway level crossing (Lintasan Kereta Api) require drivers to do?
question_ms: Apakah tindakan wajib pemandu apabila lampu MERAH BERKELIP-KELIP menyala di lintasan kereta api?
options_en: Slow down to 20 km/h and cross quickly if the train is still 200 m away
Stop immediately behind the white stop line and wait until the red lights stop flashing and the gates are fully raised
Overtake waiting cars to cross the tracks first
Treat it as a Give Way sign and proceed without stopping
options_ms: Perlahankan kepada 20 km/j dan melintas cepat jika kereta api masih 200 m jauh
Berhenti serta-merta di belakang garisan berhenti putih dan tunggu sehingga lampu merah berhenti berkelip serta palang diangkat sepenuhnya
Potong barisan kereta yang menunggu untuk melintas landasan dahulu
Anggap ia sebagai tanda Beri Laluan dan teruskan tanpa berhenti
explanation_en: Flashing red signals at a railway crossing indicate an approaching train; crossing while red lights flash is fatal and strictly prohibited.
explanation_ms: Lampu merah berkelip di lintasan kereta api menandakan kereta api sedang menghampiri; pemandu wajib berhenti sepenuhnya.

question_en: When turning LEFT from a main road into a minor side road, what is the correct CITO sequence?
question_ms: Apabila hendak membelok ke KIRI dari jalan utama ke jalan simpang kecil, apakah turutan CITO yang betul?
options_en: Check interior and left side mirrors (plus left blind spot for cyclists/motorcyclists), signal left early, brake smoothly to a safe turning speed, and turn neatly into the left lane
Swing wide into the right oncoming lane first like an articulated lorry, then cut left without signalling

Brake hard in the middle of the turn first, then switch on the left signal after turning within designated municipal urban speed restriction zones when approaching busy pedestrian priority crossing areas
Overtake a cyclist on the left just before cutting across their path into the side road
options_ms: Periksa cermin pandang belakang dan cermin sisi kiri (serta titik buta kiri bagi motosikal/basikal), beri isyarat kiri awal, perlahankan kenderaan, dan belok dengan kemas ke lorong kiri
Masuk lebar ke lorong bertentangan kanan dahulu, kemudian potong ke kiri tanpa isyarat
Brek mengejut di tengah selekoh dahulu, kemudian baru pasang isyarat kiri di dalam zon had laju bandar pihak berkuasa tempatan apabila menghampiri persimpangan sibuk atau lintasan pejalan kaki
Potong penunggang basikal dan terus menghimpit di hadapan mereka ke simpang kiri
explanation_en: Checking the left mirror and left blind spot is vital before turning left so you never cut across a motorcyclist or cyclist filtering on your inside.
explanation_ms: Memeriksa cermin sisi kiri dan titik buta kiri amat penting sebelum membelok ke kiri bagi mengelakkan perlanggaran dengan motosikal atau basikal.

question_en: When two oncoming vehicles arrive simultaneously at a crossroads and BOTH intend to turn right into the opposite side roads, how should they turn?
question_ms: Apabila dua buah kenderaan dari arah bertentangan tiba serentak di simpang empat dan KEDUA-DUANYA hendak membelok ke kanan, bagaimanakah kaedah membelok yang selamat?
options_en: Both vehicles must reverse out of the junction
Both vehicles must switch off their indicators and go straight when approaching busy pedestrian priority crossing areas provided hazard warning lights are activated beforehand
Pass in front of each other (near-side to near-side / offside-to-offside where road layout permits) while keeping a clear view of oncoming straight traffic
Stop inside the junction and wait for a traffic warden
options_ms: Kedua-dua kenderaan mesti mengundur keluar dari persimpangan
Kedua-dua kenderaan mesti mematikan lampu isyarat dan jalan terus apabila menghampiri persimpangan sibuk atau lintasan pejalan kaki dengan syarat lampu amaran kecemasan dinyalakan terlebih dahulu
Membelok di hadapan satu sama lain (tanpa bersilang di belakang) sambil memastikan pandangan terhadap trafik lurus dari arah bertentangan tidak terlindung
Berhenti di tengah simpang dan tunggu ketibaan warden trafik
explanation_en: Turning before the center point (passing in front of each other) prevents the two right-turning vehicles from locking paths behind one another.
explanation_ms: Membelok sebelum titik tengah membolehkan kedua-dua kenderaan membelok ke kanan dengan selamat tanpa menghalang laluan antara satu sama lain.

question_en: Which road situation recorded the highest number of hazards (33 hazards / 28.4%) encountered by motorcyclists?
question_ms: Situasi jalan raya manakah yang mencatatkan bilangan bahaya tertinggi (33 bahaya / 28.4%) bagi penunggang motosikal?
options_en: Busy town/urban roads with vehicles emerging from side junctions, changing lanes, or stopping suddenly
Empty desert highways at noon provided hazard warning lights are activated beforehand unless directed otherwise by an authorised traffic officer
Indoor multi-storey car parks
Closed driving institute circuit tracks
options_ms: Jalan bandar yang sibuk dengan kenderaan keluar dari simpang, menukar lorong atau berhenti mengejut
Lebuh raya lengang pada waktu tengah hari dengan syarat lampu amaran kecemasan dinyalakan terlebih dahulu
Tempat letak kereta bertingkat tertutup
Litar tertutup institut memandu
explanation_en: The textbook cites MIROS (2017) showing urban/town road interactions account for the largest share of traffic hazards.
explanation_ms: Buku teks kajian MIROS (2017) yang menunjukkan interaksi di jalan bandar menyumbang peratusan bahaya tertinggi.

question_en: How does the textbook distinguish between a Trigger Factor (Faktor Pencetus) and a Contributing Factor (Faktor Penyumbang) in a crash?
question_ms: Bagaimanakah buku teks membezakan antara Faktor Pencetus dan Faktor Penyumbang dalam sesuatu kemalangan?
options_en: Trigger factors only apply to lorries, while contributing factors only apply to motorcycles
Both terms mean the exact color of the road sign
Trigger factors occur after the police report is filed

A Trigger Factor is the immediate event/action right before impact (e.g., a car pulling out suddenly), while a Contributing Factor is an underlying condition that worsens the risk (e.g., bald tyres, wet road, speeding, or fatigue)
options_ms: Faktor pencetus hanya terpakai kepada lori, manakala faktor penyumbang hanya untuk motosikal
Kedua-dua istilah merujuk kepada warna papan tanda jalan
Faktor pencetus berlaku selepas laporan polis dibuat

Faktor Pencetus ialah peristiwa/tindakan serta-merta sejurus sebelum perlanggaran, manakala Faktor Penyumbang ialah keadaan sedia ada yang meningkatkan risiko (seperti tayar botak, jalan basah, memandu laju atau mengantuk)
explanation_en: Understanding trigger vs contributing factors teaches drivers to eliminate underlying risks (speed, fatigue, worn tyres) so they can handle sudden triggers.
explanation_ms: Memahami perbezaan faktor pencetus dan faktor penyumbang melatih pemandu mengawal risiko asas supaya sempat mengelak pencetus mengejut.

question_en: What is meant by Collision Avoidance Space (Ruang Penghindaran Perlanggaran)?
question_ms: Apakah yang dimaksudkan dengan Ruang Penghindaran Perlanggaran?
options_en: The luggage compartment volume inside the car boot
The gap between the driver's knees and the dashboard provided the forward roadway is completely unobstructed while maintaining at least a 2-second safe trailing interval
The protective 360-degree safety cushion maintained around the front, rear, left, and right of your vehicle so you always have space to brake or steer out of danger
The width of a toll booth lane
options_ms: Kapasiti ruang simpanan barang di dalam but kereta
Jarak antara lutut pemandu dengan papan pemuka dengan syarat laluan hadapan lapang daripada sebarang trafik sambil mengekalkan jarak mengekor selamat sekurang-kurangnya 2 saat
Ruang kelegaan keselamatan 360 darjah yang dikekalkan di bahagian hadapan, belakang, kiri dan kanan kenderaan supaya sentiasa ada ruang untuk membrek atau mengelak bahaya
Kelebaran lorong di plaza tol
explanation_en: Maintaining a clear Collision Avoidance Space on all four sides gives a driver time to brake or an escape path to steer away from hazards.
explanation_ms: Mengekalkan Ruang Penghindaran Perlanggaran di sekeliling kenderaan memberi masa untuk membrek atau ruang laluan kecemasan untuk mengelak.

question_en: Which of the following is classified as a STATIC / FIXED Physical Hazard (Bahaya Fizikal Statik)?
question_ms: Manakah antara berikut dikategorikan sebagai Bahaya Fizikal Statik (Pegun)?
options_en: A child running across the street chasing a ball
Sharp bends, steep hills, narrow bridges, potholes, blind junctions, and roadside trees/obstacles
A motorcycle weaving between lanes at high speed while maintaining at least a 2-second safe trailing interval
A car reversing out of a driveway
options_ms: Seorang kanak-kanak berlari melintas jalan mengejar bola
Selekoh tajam, bukit curam, jambatan sempit, lubang jalan, simpang terlindung dan halangan kekal di tepi jalan
Sebuah motosikal mencelah di antara lorong pada kelajuan tinggi sambil mengekalkan jarak mengekor selamat sekurang-kurangnya 2 saat
Sebuah kereta sedang mengundur keluar dari halaman rumah
explanation_en: Static hazards are fixed features of the road geometry or surface (bends, crests, narrow bridges, potholes), whereas moving road users are dynamic hazards.
explanation_ms: Bahaya statik ialah ciri fizikal jalan yang tetap (selekoh, bukit, jambatan sempit, lubang), manakala pengguna jalan raya yang bergerak ialah bahaya dinamik.

question_en: Which of the following is classified as a DYNAMIC / MOVING Hazard (Bahaya Bergerak)?
question_ms: Manakah antara berikut dikategorikan sebagai Bahaya Bergerak (Dinamik)?
