Abaikan papan tanda ini di luar waktu puncak hari bekerja
Sentiasa peka pada waktu malam atau hujan dan elakkan bahagian permulaan pembahagi jalan
explanation_en: When encountering 'Obstacle marker (Penanda Halangan) warning of a road divider or median pier ahead', you must: Stay alert at night or in rain and steer clear of the median nose or bridge pier.
explanation_ms: Apabila menemui tanda 'Penanda halangan yang menandakan terdapat pembahagi jalan atau halangan di hadapan', anda hendaklah: Sentiasa peka pada waktu malam atau hujan dan elakkan bahagian permulaan pembahagi jalan.

question_en: What is the safest and legally required driver action when you encounter this sign (Clearance markers)?
question_ms: Apakah tindakan pemandu yang paling selamat dan mematuhi undang-undang apabila menemui tanda ini (Penanda kelegaan yang menggambarkan hujung jambatan, halangan atau kelegaan jalan mengecil di hadapan)?
options_en: Pass between the left and right striped markers where the downward stripes point toward the safe travel lane
Accelerate quickly to pass the area before oncoming vehicles arrive
Drive on the unpaved road shoulder with hazard lights flashing
Sound the horn continuously and straddle the center line requiring selection of a lower transmission ratio on high-volume single carriageway trunk routes
options_ms: Pandu di antara penanda berjalur kiri dan kanan mengikut arah condong jalur ke bawah menuju ruang laluan selamat
Pecut laju untuk melepasi kawasan tersebut sebelum kenderaan bertentangan tiba
Pandu di atas bahu jalan tidak berturap sambil memasang lampu kecemasan
Bunyikan hon secara berterusan dan memandu di atas garisan tengah jalan yang memerlukan pemilihan nisbah gear yang lebih rendah
explanation_en: When encountering 'Clearance markers (Penanda Kelegaan) marking a bridge abutment or narrowed carriageway width', you must: Pass between the left and right striped markers where the downward stripes point toward the safe travel lane.
explanation_ms: Apabila menemui tanda 'Penanda kelegaan yang menggambarkan hujung jambatan, halangan atau kelegaan jalan mengecil di hadapan', anda hendaklah: Pandu di antara penanda berjalur kiri dan kanan mengikut arah condong jalur ke bawah menuju ruang laluan selamat.

question_en: What is the safest and legally required driver action when you encounter this sign (Winding road)?
question_ms: Apakah tindakan pemandu yang paling selamat dan mematuhi undang-undang apabila menemui tanda ini (Jalan bengkang-bengkok dengan siri selekoh berturut-turut di hadapan)?
options_en: Shift into Neutral (N) and coast freely without using the brakes
Reduce speed before the first bend, avoid overtaking, and select a lower gear for better control
Overtake slower vehicles immediately on the right side on high-volume single carriageway trunk routes
Stop in the middle of the lane and reverse to the previous junction
options_ms: Tukar gear kepada Neutral (N) dan biarkan kenderaan meluncur bebas tanpa brek
Perlahankan kenderaan sebelum selekoh pertama, elakkan memotong, dan gunakan gear rendah untuk kawalan
Potong kenderaan perlahan dengan serta-merta di sebelah kanan di laluan jalan raya tunggal dengan aliran trafik yang tinggi
Berhenti di tengah lorong dan mengundur semula ke simpang sebelumnya
explanation_en: When encountering 'Winding road (Jalan Bengkang-Bengkok) with a series of bends ahead', you must: Reduce speed before the first bend, avoid overtaking, and select a lower gear for better control.
explanation_ms: Apabila menemui tanda 'Jalan bengkang-bengkok dengan siri selekoh berturut-turut di hadapan', anda hendaklah: Perlahankan kenderaan sebelum selekoh pertama, elakkan memotong, dan gunakan gear rendah untuk kawalan.

question_en: What is the safest and legally required driver action when you encounter this sign (Sharp curve chevron alignment sign indicating the direction and severity of a dangerous bend)?
question_ms: Apakah tindakan pemandu yang paling selamat dan mematuhi undang-undang apabila menemui tanda ini (Tanda arah selekoh bahaya)?
options_en: Switch on high-beam headlights and maintain maximum highway speed located within 100 metres before the main roadway junction
Follow less than 1 second behind the vehicle ahead to save space
Follow the direction of the black chevron arrows and reduce speed immediately
Ignore the sign outside peak weekday rush hours
options_ms: Pasang lampu tinggi dan kekalkan kelajuan maksimum lebuh raya dalam jarak 100 meter sebelum tiba di persimpangan jalan
Mengekori kurang daripada 1 saat di belakang kenderaan hadapan
Ikut arah anak panah chevron hitam dan kurangkan kelajuan dengan serta-merta
Abaikan papan tanda ini di luar waktu puncak hari bekerja
explanation_en: When encountering 'Sharp curve chevron alignment sign indicating the direction and severity of a dangerous bend', you must: Follow the direction of the black chevron arrows and reduce speed immediately.
explanation_ms: Apabila menemui tanda 'Tanda arah selekoh bahaya (chevron) yang menunjukkan arah dan ketajaman selekoh di hadapan', anda hendaklah: Ikut arah anak panah chevron hitam dan kurangkan kelajuan dengan serta-merta.

question_en: What is the safest and legally required driver action when you encounter this sign (Dual carriageway)?
question_ms: Apakah tindakan pemandu yang paling selamat dan mematuhi undang-undang apabila menemui tanda ini (Jalan dua hala berkembar berakhir di hadapan — jalan bertukar menjadi jalan tunggal dua hala)?
options_en: Accelerate quickly to pass the area before oncoming vehicles arrive
Drive on the unpaved road shoulder with hazard lights flashing
Sound the horn continuously and straddle the center line
Merge safely and remember that oncoming traffic will no longer be separated by a central divider
options_ms: Pecut laju untuk melepasi kawasan tersebut sebelum kenderaan bertentangan tiba
Pandu di atas bahu jalan tidak berturap sambil memasang lampu kecemasan
Bunyikan hon secara berterusan dan memandu di atas garisan tengah jalan
Bercantum dengan selamat dan ingat bahawa trafik arah bertentangan tidak lagi dipisahkan oleh pembahagi jalan
explanation_en: When encountering 'Dual carriageway (divided highway) ends ahead — road becomes a single two-way carriageway', you must: Merge safely and remember that oncoming traffic will no longer be separated by a central divider.
explanation_ms: Apabila menemui tanda 'Jalan dua hala berkembar berakhir di hadapan — jalan bertukar menjadi jalan tunggal dua hala', anda hendaklah: Bercantum dengan selamat dan ingat bahawa trafik arah bertentangan tidak lagi dipisahkan oleh pembahagi jalan.

question_en: What happens if a commercial goods/bus driver or a Probationary (PDL) driver commits the scheduled offence of 'Driving in the right-hand overtaking lane continuously without overtaking'?
question_ms: Apakah kesan mata demerit sekiranya pemandu kenderaan perdagangan atau pemegang Lesen Memandu Percubaan (PDL) melakukan kesalahan 'Memandu di lorong kanan secara berterusan (menghalang laluan memotong)'?
options_en: Commercial and PDL drivers are completely exempt from KEJARA demerit points provided the forward roadway is completely unobstructed while maintaining at least a 2-second safe trailing interval
It deducts RM50 from the vehicle's Touch 'n Go card automatically
It extends the driver's licence validity by 5 bonus years
It records 6 demerit points for a commercial driver (4 points for a private/PDL driver, counting toward the 20-point threshold where a PDL is revoked)
options_ms: Pemandu perdagangan dan PDL dikecualikan sepenuhnya daripada mata demerit KEJARA dengan syarat laluan hadapan lapang daripada sebarang trafik
Ia menolak RM50 daripada kad Touch 'n Go kenderaan secara automatik
Ia melanjutkan tempoh sah lesen memandu sebanyak 5 tahun tambahan
Ia mencatatkan 6 mata demerit bagi pemandu perdagangan (4 mata bagi pemandu persendirian/PDL yang dikira ke arah had 20 mata pembatalan PDL)
explanation_en: Scheduled KEJARA offences apply strictly to both CDL/commercial drivers (6 pts) and PDL holders (4 pts toward the 20-point revocation limit).
explanation_ms: Kesalahan terjadual KEJARA terpakai kepada pemandu perdagangan (6 mata) serta pemegang PDL (4 mata ke arah had 20 mata pembatalan lesen).
source_url: KPP Kelas DA/D (2021), KPP01, Rule 4 LN 166/59, m/s 171

question_en: How many demerit points are recorded against a private motor car driver for: 'Driving on the emergency lane (Lorong Kecemasan) without lawful excuse'?
question_ms: Berapakah mata demerit yang dikenakan ke atas pemandu kenderaan persendirian bagi kesalahan: 'Memandu di lorong kecemasan'?
options_en: 4 demerit points
2 demerit points
3 demerit points while maintaining at least a 2-second safe trailing interval
5 demerit points
options_ms: 4 mata demerit
2 mata demerit
3 mata demerit sambil mengekalkan jarak mengekor selamat sekurang-kurangnya 2 saat
5 mata demerit
explanation_en: Under the KEJARA schedule, 'Driving on the emergency lane (Lorong Kecemasan) without lawful excuse' carries 4 demerit points for a private driver (and 6 points for a commercial vehicle driver).
explanation_ms: Di bawah jadual KEJARA, kesalahan 'Memandu di lorong kecemasan' membawa 4 mata demerit bagi pemandu persendirian (dan 6 mata bagi pemandu kenderaan perdagangan).
source_url: KPP Kelas DA/D (2021), KPP01, Rule 53 LN 166/59, m/s 172

question_en: What happens if a commercial goods/bus driver or a Probationary (PDL) driver commits the scheduled offence of 'Driving on the emergency lane (Lorong Kecemasan) without lawful excuse'?
question_ms: Apakah kesan mata demerit sekiranya pemandu kenderaan perdagangan atau pemegang Lesen Memandu Percubaan (PDL) melakukan kesalahan 'Memandu di lorong kecemasan'?
options_en: Commercial and PDL drivers are completely exempt from KEJARA demerit points
It deducts RM50 from the vehicle's Touch 'n Go card automatically
It extends the driver's licence validity by 5 bonus years after verifying mirrors and shoulder blind spot clear during clear daylight hours on dry tarmac carriageways
It records 6 demerit points for a commercial driver (4 points for a private/PDL driver, counting toward the 20-point threshold where a PDL is revoked)
options_ms: Pemandu perdagangan dan PDL dikecualikan sepenuhnya daripada mata demerit KEJARA
Ia menolak RM50 daripada kad Touch 'n Go kenderaan secara automatik
Ia melanjutkan tempoh sah lesen memandu sebanyak 5 tahun tambahan selepas memeriksa cermin sisi dan titik buta pandangan belakang semasa waktu siang cerah pada permukaan jalan berturap kering
Ia mencatatkan 6 mata demerit bagi pemandu perdagangan (4 mata bagi pemandu persendirian/PDL yang dikira ke arah had 20 mata pembatalan PDL)
explanation_en: Scheduled KEJARA offences apply strictly to both CDL/commercial drivers (6 pts) and PDL holders (4 pts toward the 20-point revocation limit).

question_en: In the KPP Safe Overtaking Procedure, what is the crucial initial consideration before deciding to overtake?
question_ms: Dalam Prosedur Memotong Selamat KPP, apakah pertimbangan awal yang paling penting sebelum membuat keputusan memotong?
options_en: Flash high beam headlights repeatedly and sound the horn continuously for 5 seconds
Verify whether overtaking is truly necessary, legal, and safe while maintaining a safe following distance
Accelerate immediately to expressway speed while still remaining directly behind the lead vehicle
Shift steering wheel quickly into the oncoming lane before checking mirrors to test road space
options_ms: Menyalakan lampu tinggi berturut-turut dan membunyikan hon secara berterusan selama 5 saat
Menilai sama ada memotong benar-benar perlu, sah di sisi undang-undang, dan selamat sambil mengekalkan jarak mengekor
Memecut serta-merta pada kelajuan lebuh raya semasa masih berada rapat di belakang kenderaan hadapan
Memusing stereng secara pantas ke lorong bertentangan sebelum memeriksa cermin bagi menguji ruang
explanation_en: Safe overtaking begins by keeping a 2-second gap so you have a wide view of the road ahead and room to build speed.
explanation_ms: Memotong secara selamat bermula dengan mengekalkan jarak 2 saat supaya pandangan ke hadapan tidak terhalang.

question_en: Step 2 of the KPP Safe Overtaking Procedure: How far ahead must you scan the road before pulling out to overtake?
question_ms: Langkah 2 dalam Prosedur Memotong Selamat KPP: Sejauh manakah anda perlu mengimbas keadaan jalan di hadapan sebelum keluar memotong?
options_en: Look only 1 second ahead of your front bumper
Look only at the rear licence plate of the car ahead
Check only the fuel gauge provided hazard warning lights are activated beforehand unless directed otherwise by an authorised traffic officer provided the forward roadway is completely unobstructed
Scan at least 12 seconds ahead (Peraturan 12 Saat) to verify there are no oncoming vehicles, hidden dips, hill crests, bends, or side junctions
options_ms: Lihat hanya 1 saat di hadapan bampar kereta anda
Lihat hanya nombor plat belakang kereta di hadapan

Periksa meter bahan api sahaja dengan syarat lampu amaran kecemasan dinyalakan terlebih dahulu melainkan diarahkan sebaliknya oleh pegawai trafik yang bertugas dengan syarat laluan hadapan lapang daripada sebarang trafik
Perhatikan laluan di hadapan sekurang-kurangnya sejauh 12 saat (Peraturan 12 Saat) bagi memastikan tiada kenderaan bertentangan, puncak bukit, selekoh atau simpang
explanation_en: The 12-Second Rule ensures the overtaking zone is completely free of oncoming traffic and road geometry hazards.
explanation_ms: Peraturan 12 Saat memastikan zon memotong bebas sepenuhnya daripada trafik bertentangan dan bahaya bentuk jalan.

question_en: Step 3 of the KPP Safe Overtaking Procedure: Why must you check your interior rear-view mirror, right side mirror, and right blind spot before signalling right?
question_ms: Langkah 3 dalam Prosedur Memotong Selamat KPP: Mengapakah anda mesti memeriksa cermin pandang belakang, cermin sisi kanan, dan titik buta kanan sebelum keluar memotong?
options_en: To check if your rear windscreen wiper is clean
To admire the paintwork on your rear door
Because checking mirrors automatically increases engine horsepower
To ensure another faster vehicle or motorcycle behind you has not already begun overtaking your car in the right lane
options_ms: Untuk memeriksa sama ada pengelap cermin belakang bersih
Untuk melihat kemasan cat pada pintu belakang
Kerana memeriksa cermin meningkatkan kuasa enjin secara automatik
Bagi memastikan tiada kenderaan lain atau motosikal dari arah belakang yang sedang memotong kenderaan anda di lorong kanan
explanation_en: Pulling out without checking mirrors and the right blind spot is a major cause of sideswipe collisions with overtaking vehicles or motorcycles.
explanation_ms: Keluar memotong tanpa memeriksa cermin dan titik buta kanan sering menyebabkan perlanggaran sisi dengan kenderaan yang sedang memotong dari belakang.

question_en: Step 4 of the KPP Safe Overtaking Procedure: How long should you activate your right turn indicator before moving into the overtaking lane?
question_ms: Langkah 4 dalam Prosedur Memotong Selamat KPP: Berapa lamakah anda perlu memasang lampu isyarat kanan sebelum bergerak masuk ke lorong memotong?
options_en: Flick the indicator for 0.1 seconds after already crossing the center line
Switch on the left indicator while moving right provided the forward roadway is completely unobstructed while maintaining at least a 2-second safe trailing interval
Use the windscreen wipers instead of turn signals
Signal right clearly for at least 3 seconds before moving out so both the driver ahead and drivers behind understand your intention
options_ms: Pasang isyarat selama 0.1 saat selepas melintasi garisan tengah
Pasang lampu isyarat kiri semasa bergerak ke kanan dengan syarat laluan hadapan lapang daripada sebarang trafik sambil mengekalkan jarak mengekor selamat sekurang-kurangnya 2 saat
Gunakan pengelap cermin sebagai ganti lampu isyarat
Pasang lampu isyarat kanan dengan jelas sekurang-kurangnya selama 3 saat sebelum keluar memotong supaya disedari oleh pemandu di hadapan dan belakang
explanation_en: Signalling right for at least 3 seconds gives surrounding road users adequate warning before you change lanes.
explanation_ms: Memberi lampu isyarat kanan sekurang-kurangnya 3 saat memberi masa yang mencukupi kepada pengguna jalan raya lain untuk menyedari pergerakan anda.

question_en: Step 5 of the KPP Safe Overtaking Procedure: Which gear and speed adjustment should you make when executing an overtake?
question_ms: Langkah 5 dalam Prosedur Memotong Selamat KPP: Apakah pelarasan gear dan kelajuan yang wajar dilakukan semasa memotong?
options_en: Shift into Neutral (N) and coast slowly past the lorry while maintaining at least a 2-second safe trailing interval after verifying mirrors and shoulder blind spot clear
Select a responsive gear if needed and accelerate briskly (without exceeding the statutory speed limit) to minimize time spent in the overtaking lane
Apply the handbrake lightly while overtaking
Drive side-by-side at the exact same speed for 5 kilometres
options_ms: Tukar ke gear Neutral (N) dan meluncur perlahan melepasi lori sambil mengekalkan jarak mengekor selamat sekurang-kurangnya 2 saat selepas memeriksa cermin sisi dan titik buta pandangan belakang
Pilih gear yang memberikan kuasa responsif jika perlu dan pecut dengan lancar (tanpa melebihi had laju ditetapkan) bagi memendekkan masa di lorong memotong
Tarik brek tangan sedikit semasa sedang memotong
Memandu beriringan pada kelajuan yang sama sejauh 5 kilometer
explanation_en: Completing the pass briskly within the legal speed limit minimizes exposure in the overtaking lane.
explanation_ms: Menyelesaikan gerakan memotong dengan pantas tanpa melebihi had laju meminimumkan tempoh berada di lorong bertentangan.

question_en: Step 6 of the KPP Safe Overtaking Procedure: When passing alongside a vehicle during an overtake, when may you briefly tap the horn or flash headlights?
question_ms: Langkah 6 dalam Prosedur Memotong Selamat KPP: Semasa melintasi di sebelah kenderaan yang dipotong, bilakah anda boleh membunyikan hon pendek atau mengelipkan lampu?
options_en: Hold the horn down continuously for 30 seconds next to hospitals
Flash high beams into the eyes of oncoming traffic
Only as a polite brief alert if the driver ahead appears unaware of your presence or starts drifting toward the center line
Never alert a drifting lorry driver under any circumstances after verifying mirrors and shoulder blind spot clear during clear daylight hours on dry tarmac carriageways
options_ms: Tekan hon tanpa henti selama 30 saat di hadapan hospital
Suluh lampu tinggi tepat ke mata pemandu dari arah bertentangan
Hanya sebagai isyarat amaran ringkas jika pemandu di hadapan kelihatan tidak menyedari kehadiran anda atau mula menghimpit ke garisan tengah
Jangan sesekali memberi amaran walaupun lori menghimpit lorong anda selepas memeriksa cermin sisi dan titik buta pandangan belakang semasa waktu siang cerah pada permukaan jalan berturap kering
explanation_en: A brief horn tap (daytime) or headlight flash (night) alerts a driver who may not have noticed you in their mirror.
explanation_ms: Bunyi hon pendek (waktu siang) atau kelipan lampu (waktu malam) memberi peringatan berhemah kepada pemandu hadapan.

question_en: Step 7 of the KPP Safe Overtaking Procedure: After passing the vehicle and seeing both its headlights in your interior mirror, what must you do before moving back to the left lane?
question_ms: Langkah 7 dalam Prosedur Memotong Selamat KPP: Selepas melepasi kenderaan yang dipotong dan melihat kedua-dua lampu hadapannya di cermin pandang belakang, apakah langkah seterusnya?
options_en: Brake hard immediately in front of the overtaken lorry
Stay permanently in the right oncoming lane
Switch on hazard lights and slow down to 20 km/h
Check your left side mirror, switch on your LEFT turn indicator, and glide smoothly back into the left lane without cutting in sharply
options_ms: Tekan brek secara mengejut betul-betul di hadapan lori yang baru dipotong
Kekal memandu di lorong bertentangan kanan sepanjang masa
Pasang lampu kecemasan dan perlahankan kepada 20 km/j
Periksa cermin sisi kiri, pasang lampu isyarat KIRI, dan masuk semula ke lorong kiri secara lancar tanpa memotong secara mengejut
explanation_en: Signalling left and merging smoothly only after seeing the overtaken vehicle in your interior mirror avoids clipping its front bumper.
explanation_ms: Memberi isyarat kiri dan masuk semula secara lancar selepas melihat kenderaan tersebut di cermin pandang belakang mengelakkan perlanggaran himpit.

question_en: Step 8 of the KPP Safe Overtaking Procedure: What is the final step after returning completely to the left cruising lane?
question_ms: Langkah 8 dalam Prosedur Memotong Selamat KPP: Apakah langkah terakhir selepas kenderaan anda kembali berada sepenuhnya di lorong kiri?
options_en: Leave the left indicator blinking for the rest of the journey within designated municipal urban speed restriction zones
Cancel your left turn indicator and resume a safe cruising speed and 2-second following distance
Immediately slam on the brakes to test the driver behind
Shift into Reverse to check the gearbox
options_ms: Biarkan lampu isyarat kiri terus berkelip sepanjang perjalanan di dalam zon had laju bandar pihak berkuasa tempatan
Matikan lampu isyarat kiri dan kekalkan kelajuan pemanduan yang selamat serta jarak mengekori 2 saat
Tekan brek mengejut untuk menguji pemandu di belakang
Masukkan gear Undur untuk menguji kotak gear
explanation_en: Always cancel your turn signal after completing the lane change so you do not mislead traffic at upcoming side roads.
explanation_ms: Sentiasa pastikan lampu isyarat dimatikan selepas selesai masuk semula ke lorong kiri supaya tidak mengelirukan pemandu di simpang hadapan.

question_en: When driving through a School Zone (Zon Sekolah) during school arrival or dismissal hours, what speed limit and precaution apply?
question_ms: Semasa memandu melalui Zon Sekolah pada waktu murid datang atau pulang dari sekolah, apakah had laju dan langkah berjaga-jaga yang wajib diamalkan?
options_en: Maintain 90 km/h and sound the horn to scatter children
Overtake stationary school buses on the left side
Slow down to 30 km/h or below, scan both footpaths for children, never overtake, and stop immediately when a school crossing warden raises the STOP paddle
Stop only if a police patrol car is parked at the gate when approaching busy pedestrian priority crossing areas provided hazard warning lights are activated beforehand
options_ms: Kekalkan 90 km/j dan bunyikan hon supaya murid-murid ketepi
Potong bas sekolah yang sedang berhenti melalui sebelah kiri
Perlahankan kenderaan kepada 30 km/j atau kurang, perhatikan kedua-dua bahu jalan, dilarang memotong, dan berhenti serta-merta apabila pengawal lintasan mengangkat papan BERHENTI
Berhenti hanya jika terdapat kereta peronda polis di pintu pagar apabila menghampiri persimpangan sibuk atau lintasan pejalan kaki dengan syarat lampu amaran kecemasan dinyalakan terlebih dahulu
explanation_en: School zones enforce a 30 km/h speed limit and strict compliance with school crossing wardens between 6:00 a.m. and 7:00 p.m.
explanation_ms: Zon sekolah menetapkan had laju 30 km/j serta pematuhan wajib terhadap arahan pengawal lintasan sekolah.

question_en: At an uncontrolled Zebra Pedestrian Crossing (Lintasan Belang tanpa lampu isyarat), who has legal priority?
question_ms: Di Lintasan Belang Pejalan Kaki yang tidak mempunyai lampu isyarat, siapakah yang mempunyai hak keutamaan di sisi undang-undang?
options_en: Motor vehicles always have priority over pedestrians on zebra stripes
Any pedestrian who has stepped onto or is waiting at the zebra crossing has priority; approaching vehicles must slow down and stop behind the white line
Only pedestrians wearing high-visibility vests have priority
Cars may weave between pedestrians as long as they do not hit them provided hazard warning lights are activated beforehand unless directed otherwise by an authorised traffic officer
options_ms: Kenderaan bermotor sentiasa mempunyai keutamaan mengatasi pejalan kaki
Pejalan kaki yang sedang melintas atau menunggu di lintasan belang mempunyai keutamaan; kenderaan yang menghampiri wajib memperlahankan kelajuan dan berhenti di belakang garisan putih
Hanya pejalan kaki yang memakai jaket pantulan cahaya diberi laluan

Kereta boleh mencelah di antara pejalan kaki selagi tidak melanggar mereka dengan syarat lampu amaran kecemasan dinyalakan terlebih dahulu melainkan diarahkan sebaliknya oleh pegawai trafik yang bertugas
explanation_en: Under Rule 13 of the Road Traffic Rules, drivers must yield to pedestrians on a marked pedestrian crossing.
explanation_ms: Di bawah Kaedah 13 Kaedah-Kaedah Lalu Lintas Jalan, pemandu wajib memberi laluan kepada pejalan kaki di lintasan belang.

question_en: At a signalised pedestrian crossing (Lintasan Pejalan Kaki Berlampu Isyarat), the traffic light for vehicles turns green, but an elderly pedestrian is still halfway across the road. What must you do?
question_ms: Di lintasan pejalan kaki berlampu isyarat, lampu untuk kenderaan telah bertukar hijau tetapi seorang warga emas masih berada di tengah lintasan. Apakah tindakan wajib anda?
options_en: Drive forward immediately because the green light gives absolute right of way
Sound the horn loudly and drive around their heels
Remain stationary and wait patiently until the pedestrian has safely reached the footpath before moving off — never rev the engine or sound the horn
Flash high-beam headlights to make them run
options_ms: Terus bergerak kerana lampu hijau memberi hak mutlak kepada pemandu
Bunyikan hon dengan kuat dan pandu rapat di belakang beliau
Kekal berhenti dengan sabar sehingga warga emas tersebut selamat tiba di bahu jalan sebelum bergerak — jangan membunyikan hon atau menekan minyak secara agresif
Kelipkan lampu tinggi untuk memaksa beliau berlari
explanation_en: A green light means you may proceed only if the way is clear; vulnerable pedestrians still completing their crossing always retain safety priority.
explanation_ms: Lampu hijau hanya membenarkan pemandu bergerak jika laluan di hadapan selamat dan kosong; keselamatan pejalan kaki mesti diutamakan.

question_en: You see a pedestrian holding a white cane waiting at the side of a road crossing. What does the white cane signify and how should you respond?
question_ms: Anda melihat seorang pejalan kaki memegang tongkat putih sedang menunggu untuk melintas jalan. Apakah maksud tongkat putih tersebut dan bagaimanakah anda harus bertindak?
options_en: Sound a long blast on the horn to tell them to hurry up
Wave your hand from inside the car so they see your gesture
The pedestrian is blind or visually impaired; come to a complete stop, do not sound the horn or rev the engine (which startles and disorients them), and wait until they finish crossing

Accelerate past before they step off the kerb provided the forward roadway is completely unobstructed while maintaining at least a 2-second safe trailing interval after verifying mirrors and shoulder blind spot clear
options_ms: Bunyikan hon panjang supaya mereka melintas dengan cepat
Lambai tangan dari dalam kereta supaya mereka melihat isyarat anda
Pejalan kaki tersebut ialah orang buta atau cacat penglihatan; berhenti sepenuhnya, jangan membunyikan hon (yang boleh mengejutkan atau mengelirukan mereka), dan tunggu sehingga selesai melintas

Pecut laju sebelum mereka melangkah turun dari bebendul jalan dengan syarat laluan hadapan lapang daripada sebarang trafik sambil mengekalkan jarak mengekor selamat sekurang-kurangnya 2 saat selepas memeriksa cermin sisi dan titik buta pandangan belakang
explanation_en: Visually impaired pedestrians rely on hearing traffic sounds; sounding the horn startles them, and hand waves cannot be seen.
explanation_ms: Pejalan kaki cacat penglihatan bergantung pada deria pendengaran; bunyi hon yang kuat boleh mengejutkan dan mengelirukan arah mereka.

question_en: When jump-starting a car with a flat 12V battery using Jumper Cables, what is the safe connection rule for the red and black clamps?
question_ms: Semasa menghidupkan kereta yang lemah bateri menggunakan Kabel Pelompat, apakah peraturan sambungan klip merah dan hitam yang selamat?
options_en: Connect the RED cable to the Positive (+) terminals of both batteries, and connect the BLACK cable from the donor battery's Negative (-) terminal to the Negative (-) terminal / unpainted metal engine ground of the flat car — never touch the red and black clamps together
Connect the red cable from positive (+) to negative (-) to create a short circuit

Hold both clamps in a bucket of water while cranking during routine pre-drive vehicle inspections and weekly checks in accordance with manufacturer vehicle service specifications to minimise mechanical fatigue and avoid unexpected part failure while maintaining a firm two-handed grip on the steering wheel
Disconnect the battery while the car is moving at 60 km/h
options_ms: Sambungkan kabel MERAH pada terminal Positif (+) kedua-dua bateri, dan kabel HITAM pada terminal Negatif (-) / bumi logam enjin — pastikan klip merah dan hitam tidak sesekali bersentuhan antara satu sama lain
Sambungkan kabel merah daripada positif (+) terus ke negatif (-) supaya berlaku litar pintas

Rendam kedua-dua klip di dalam baldi air semasa menghidupkan enjin semasa rutin pemeriksaan sebelum memandu dan semakan mingguan mengikut piawaian spesifikasi penyelenggaraan pengeluar kenderaan untuk mengurangkan kehausan mekanikal dan mengelakkan kerosakan komponen
Tanggalkan bateri semasa kereta sedang bergerak 60 km/j
explanation_en: Reversing polarity (connecting + to -) causes a violent short circuit, sparks, blown alternator diodes, and risk of battery explosion.
explanation_ms: Tersalah sambung kutub positif (+) ke negatif (-) boleh menyebabkan percikan api yang kuat, kerosakan sistem elektronik, dan risiko bateri meletup.

question_en: What type of Fire Extinguisher (Alat Pemadam Api) is recommended to be carried inside a motor vehicle?
question_ms: Apakah jenis Alat Pemadam Api yang disyorkan untuk disimpan di dalam kenderaan bermotor?
options_en: A bucket of tap water for pouring onto burning petrol
A can of cooking oil

A compressed oxygen cylinder in accordance with manufacturer vehicle service specifications to minimise mechanical fatigue and avoid unexpected part failure while maintaining a firm two-handed grip on the steering wheel

A multipurpose ABC Dry Powder (Serbuk Kering ABC) fire extinguisher suitable for flammable liquid/petrol (Class B) and electrical (Class C/E) vehicle fires, with its pressure gauge needle in the green zone
options_ms: Sebaldi air paip untuk dijirus ke atas petrol yang sedang terbakar
Setin minyak masak

Silinder gas oksigen termampat mengikut piawaian spesifikasi penyelenggaraan pengeluar kenderaan untuk mengurangkan kehausan mekanikal dan mengelakkan kerosakan komponen sambil memegang stereng dengan kemas menggunakan kedua-dua belah tangan
Alat pemadam api jenis Serbuk Kering (Dry Powder ABC) yang sesuai memadamkan kebakaran cecair mudah terbakar/petrol dan litar elektrik kenderaan, dengan jarum tolok tekanan berada di zon hijau
explanation_en: Never pour water onto a petrol/oil fire, as burning fuel floats on water and spreads the flames; use a Dry Powder ABC extinguisher aimed at the base of the fire (P.A.S.S.).
explanation_ms: Jangan sesekali menyiram air ke atas kebakaran petrol atau minyak kerana api akan merebak; gunakan pemadam api Serbuk Kering ABC.

question_en: How do you check that your Driver Seat distance from the pedals and steering wheel is adjusted correctly during RSM?
question_ms: Bagaimanakah cara memastikan jarak Tempat Duduk Pemandu dengan pedal kaki dan roda stereng telah dilaraskan dengan betul semasa RSM?
options_en: Your legs should be locked completely straight on tip-toes to reach the pedals

Your knee should retain a slight comfortable bend even when pressing the clutch/brake pedal fully to the floor, and with your shoulders resting against the seatback, your wrists should comfortably reach the top of the steering wheel rim
Your chest should be pressed within 5 cm of the steering wheel airbag cover
The seatback should be reclined flat at 45 degrees like a bed
options_ms: Kaki terpaksa diluruskan sepenuhnya secara berjengket untuk mencapai pedal

Lutut kaki masih mempunyai sedikit bengkokan yang selesa apabila menekan pedal cekam/brek sepenuhnya ke lantai, dan apabila bahu bersandar rapat pada kerusi, pergelangan tangan dapat diletakkan di bahagian atas roda stereng
Dada rapat sehingga 5 cm sahaja dari penutup beg udara stereng
Penyandar kerusi direbahkan 45 darjah seperti katil
explanation_en: Proper seat distance gives full pedal leverage in an emergency stop while keeping your chest at least 25 cm (10 inches) away from the steering airbag.
explanation_ms: Pelarasan kerusi yang betul memberikan kawalan penuh ke atas pedal dan stereng serta mengekalkan jarak selamat dada daripada beg udara.

question_en: During RSM, how should the Left and Right Exterior Side Mirrors (Cermin Sisi Kiri dan Kanan) be angled?
question_ms: Semasa melakukan RSM, bagaimanakah sudut Cermin Sisi Kiri dan Kanan harus dilaraskan dengan betul?
options_en: Angle both side mirrors inward so you only see the front door handles while maintaining a firm two-handed grip on the steering wheel to prevent hazardous brake overheating and loss of stopping force by modulating pedals smoothly and checking dashboard warning gauges
Angle both side mirrors straight up toward the sky

Angle each side mirror so the inner quarter/edge shows a sliver of the rear side of your own car body (as a spatial reference) while the outer three-quarters show the adjacent traffic lane behind you, with the horizon near the middle
Fold both side mirrors closed before driving onto the highway
options_ms: Halakan kedua-dua cermin sisi ke dalam supaya hanya nampak pemegang pintu hadapan sambil memegang stereng dengan kemas menggunakan kedua-dua belah tangan bagi mengelakkan kepanasan melampau brek dan kehilangan daya cengkaman
Halakan kedua-dua cermin sisi mendongak ke langit

Laraskan supaya bahagian tepi dalam cermin menampakkan sedikit bahagian sisi belakang badan kereta sendiri (sebagai rujukan jarak), manakala bahagian selebihnya memaparkan lorong jalan di sebelah belakang dengan jelas
Lipat kedua-dua cermin sisi rapat ke tingkap sebelum memandu
explanation_en: Even with properly adjusted interior and side mirrors, blind spots remain at the rear quarters — so always perform a brief shoulder head-check (toleh pandang) before changing lanes.
explanation_ms: Walaupun ketiga-tiga cermin telah dilaraskan dengan betul, kawasan titik buta (blind spot) masih wujud — maka sentiasa toleh sedikit kepala sebelum menukar lorong.

question_en: When you turn the ignition key to 'ON' during RSM and then start the engine, what should happen to the red dashboard warning lights (Battery Charge, Engine Oil Pressure, and Engine Check)?
question_ms: Apabila anda memusingkan kunci pencucuh ke kedudukan 'ON' semasa RSM dan kemudian menghidupkan enjin, apakah yang sepatutnya berlaku kepada lampu-lampu amaran merah pada panel meter (Bateri, Tekanan Minyak Enjin)?
options_en: They should illuminate at 'ON' (confirming the bulbs/sensors work) and then GO OUT within a few seconds after the engine starts running (except the handbrake light while the handbrake is up)
They should keep flashing bright red continuously while driving at 90 km/h
They should never light up even when the key is at 'ON'

They only light up when the radio is turned on to prevent hazardous brake overheating and loss of stopping force by modulating pedals smoothly and checking dashboard warning gauges before commencing the journey or putting the vehicle in motion
options_ms: Lampu-lampu amaran tersebut akan menyala pada kedudukan 'ON' dan kemudian PADAM sebaik sahaja enjin berjaya dihidupkan (kecuali lampu brek tangan selagi brek tangan masih ditarik)
Kesemua lampu merah tersebut patut terus menyala sepanjang perjalanan pada 90 km/j
Lampu tersebut tidak patut menyala langsung walaupun kunci pada 'ON'
Lampu tersebut hanya menyala apabila radio dipasang bagi mengelakkan kepanasan melampau brek dan kehilangan daya cengkaman dengan mengawal pedal secara lancar dan memantau tolok papan pemuka
explanation_en: If the red Oil Pressure or Battery warning light stays illuminated while the engine is running, stop safely and switch off the engine to prevent severe damage.
explanation_ms: Sekiranya lampu amaran merah Tekanan Minyak Enjin atau Bateri terus menyala selepas enjin hidup, berhentikan kenderaan di tempat selamat kerana wujud masalah teknikal.

question_en: What does it mean if the red Engine Oil Pressure warning light (oil can icon) comes on while you are driving?
question_ms: Apakah maksudnya sekiranya lampu amaran merah Tekanan Minyak Pelincir Enjin (ikon bekas minyak) menyala pada panel meter semasa anda sedang memandu?
options_en: It means the windscreen washer bottle needs water by modulating pedals smoothly and checking dashboard warning gauges before commencing the journey or putting the vehicle in motion to prevent loss of vehicle control and protect all occupants
It means the tyres need 200 kPa of air
It means it is time to turn on the air-conditioner
Engine oil pressure has dropped dangerously low (due to insufficient oil level or oil pump failure); signal left, stop safely immediately, and switch off the engine before it seizes
options_ms: Ia bermaksud tangki air pengelap cermin kehabisan air dengan mengawal pedal secara lancar dan memantau tolok papan pemuka sebelum memulakan perjalanan atau menggerakkan kenderaan bermotor bagi mengelakkan kehilangan kawalan kenderaan dan melindungi penumpang
Ia bermaksud tayar memerlukan tekanan angin 200 kPa
Ia bermaksud penyaman udara perlu dihidupkan
Tekanan minyak pelincir enjin terlalu rendah atau kekurangan minyak enjin; beri isyarat ke kiri, berhenti di tempat selamat dengan segera dan matikan enjin bagi mengelakkan enjin jem (rosak teruk)
explanation_en: Continuing to drive with the red oil-pressure warning light on will destroy the engine bearings and pistons within minutes.
explanation_ms: Meneruskan pemanduan ketika lampu amaran minyak enjin menyala boleh menyebabkan blok enjin rosak teruk (seize) dalam masa beberapa minit.

question_en: What does it mean if the Engine Coolant Temperature gauge needle climbs into the red 'H' (Hot) zone — or the red thermometer warning light comes on — while driving?
question_ms: Apakah tindakan yang betul sekiranya jarum meter Suhu Enjin (Temperature Gauge) naik ke zon merah 'H' (Panas) semasa sedang memandu?
options_en: Keep driving faster at 110 km/h to cool the engine
Immediately twist open the metal radiator cap with your bare hand while steam is hissing
Pour ice-cold water directly over the red-hot engine block

The engine is overheating; pull over safely to the roadside, switch off the engine, open the bonnet to let heat dissipate, and wait until the engine cools down completely before checking the coolant reservoir — NEVER open the hot radiator cap!
options_ms: Teruskan memandu lebih laju pada 110 km/j
Buka tudung besi radiator serta-merta dengan tangan kosong ketika wap sedang mendidih
Simbah air ais terus ke atas blok enjin yang sedang amat panas

Enjin sedang mengalami kepanasan melampau (overheating); berhenti di tepi jalan yang selamat, matikan enjin, buka bonet untuk membebaskan haba, dan tunggu sehingga enjin sejuk sepenuhnya sebelum memeriksa air — JANGAN sesekali membuka tudung radiator semasa masih panas!
explanation_en: Allow the engine to cool naturally for at least 30–45 minutes before inspecting coolant levels or hoses.
explanation_ms: Biarkan enjin menyejuk sepenuhnya terlebih dahulu bagi mengelakkan kecederaan melecur akibat semburan air panas bertekanan tinggi.

question_en: What does it mean if the red Battery / Charging System warning light stays on while you are driving?
question_ms: Apakah yang ditunjukkan sekiranya lampu amaran merah Bateri terus menyala pada panel meter semasa enjin sedang hidup dan kenderaan sedang dipandu?
options_en: The alternator charging system is not charging the battery (often due to a faulty alternator or a snapped/loose alternator drive belt)
The battery is 100% fully charged and working normally
The boot lid is slightly ajar
The headlights are on low beam to prevent loss of vehicle control and protect all occupants during routine pre-drive vehicle inspections and weekly checks
options_ms: Sistem pengecasan (alternator) gagal mengecas bateri (lazimnya berpunca daripada kerosakan alternator atau tali sawat kipas/alternator yang longgar/putus)
Bateri telah dicas 100% penuh dan berfungsi dengan baik
Penutup ruang but belakang tidak rapat
Lampu hadapan sedang dipasang pada lampu rendah bagi mengelakkan kehilangan kawalan kenderaan dan melindungi penumpang semasa rutin pemeriksaan sebelum memandu dan semakan mingguan
explanation_en: If the alternator belt has snapped, the water pump may also stop turning — check the engine bay safely and drive to the nearest workshop before the battery drains.
explanation_ms: Jika tali sawat alternator putus, pam air radiator juga mungkin berhenti berpusing — periksa ruang enjin dengan selamat dan dapatkan pemeriksaan bengkel segera.

question_en: If a Class DA Automatic car breaks down and must be towed to a workshop, why should it NOT be towed long distances with its drive wheels rolling on the road in 'N'?
question_ms: Sekiranya kereta Kelas DA Automatik mengalami kerosakan dan perlu ditunda ke bengkel, mengapakah ia TIDAK wajar ditunda jarak jauh dengan roda pacuan berpusing di atas jalan dalam gear 'N'?
options_en: Because towing in 'N' makes the horn blow continuously

When the engine is off, the automatic transmission oil pump does not circulate ATF, so spinning the output shaft over long distances can overheat and burn out the gearbox bearings and clutches; use a flatbed carrier or lift the drive wheels off the road

Because the tyres will turn inside out during routine pre-drive vehicle inspections and weekly checks in accordance with manufacturer vehicle service specifications to minimise mechanical fatigue and avoid unexpected part failure while maintaining a firm two-handed grip on the steering wheel
Because the fuel tank will overflow
options_ms: Kerana menunda dalam 'N' menyebabkan hon berbunyi tanpa henti

Apabila enjin mati, pam minyak kotak gear automatik tidak berfungsi; membiarkan roda pacuan berpusing jarak jauh tanpa pelinciran akan membakar komponen dalaman transmisi, maka gunakan lori pengangkut (flatbed) atau angkat roda pacuan

Kerana tayar akan terbalik keluar semasa rutin pemeriksaan sebelum memandu dan semakan mingguan mengikut piawaian spesifikasi penyelenggaraan pengeluar kenderaan untuk mengurangkan kehausan mekanikal dan mengelakkan kerosakan komponen sambil memegang stereng dengan kemas menggunakan kedua-dua belah tangan
Kerana tangki bahan api akan melimpah
explanation_en: Always transport a disabled automatic car on a flatbed recovery truck or with its driven wheels lifted clear of the tarmac.
explanation_ms: Sentiasa angkut kereta automatik yang rosak di atas lori tunda pelantar (flatbed) atau dengan mengangkat roda pacuan daripada menyentuh permukaan jalan.
source_url: KPP Kelas DA Automatik (2021), KPP02, m/s 201

question_en: When waiting stationary at a red traffic light on a flat road in a Class DA Automatic car for more than a brief moment, what is the safest practice recommended in KPP02?
question_ms: Semasa berhenti menunggu lampu isyarat merah yang agak lama di jalan rata dengan kereta Kelas DA Automatik, apakah amalan keselamatan terbaik yang disarankan dalam KPP02?
options_en: Shift into 'R' (Reverse) while waiting at the red light

Switch off the headlights and hazard lights and leave the car in 'D' without holding any brake in accordance with manufacturer vehicle service specifications to minimise mechanical fatigue and avoid unexpected part failure
Hold the brake with the left foot and rev the engine with the right foot
Keep the footbrake applied, pull the handbrake firmly, and shift the selector to 'N' (Neutral) so the car cannot creep forward if your foot slips off the brake pedal
options_ms: Tukar tuil gear ke kedudukan 'R' (Undur) semasa menunggu lampu merah

Biarkan gear dalam 'D' tanpa menekan brek kaki atau menarik brek tangan mengikut piawaian spesifikasi penyelenggaraan pengeluar kenderaan untuk mengurangkan kehausan mekanikal dan mengelakkan kerosakan komponen
Tekan brek dengan kaki kiri sambil menekan pemecut dengan kaki kanan
Tekan brek kaki, tarik brek tangan dengan kemas, dan letakkan tuil gear pada kedudukan 'N' (Neutral) supaya kereta tidak meluru ke hadapan jika kaki terlepas daripada pedal brek
explanation_en: Engaging the handbrake and 'N' during long traffic light stops relieves transmission drag and prevents accidental rear-end collisions.
explanation_ms: Menarik brek tangan dan meletakkan gear pada 'N' ketika menunggu lama di lampu isyarat mengelakkan risiko terlepas brek kaki dan melanggar kereta di hadapan.
source_url: KPP Kelas DA Automatik (2021), KPP02, m/s 200, 210

question_en: What is the safest and legally required driver action when you encounter this sign (Roundabout)?
question_ms: Apakah tindakan pemandu yang paling selamat dan mematuhi undang-undang apabila menemui tanda ini (Bulatan di hadapan)?
options_en: Slow down, choose the correct approach lane, and give way to traffic circulating from the right
Shift into Neutral (N) and coast freely without using the brakes
Overtake slower vehicles immediately on the right side
Stop in the middle of the lane and reverse to the previous junction
options_ms: Perlahankan kenderaan, pilih lorong masuk yang betul, dan beri laluan kepada trafik dari sebelah kanan di dalam bulatan
Tukar gear kepada Neutral (N) dan biarkan kenderaan meluncur bebas tanpa brek
Potong kenderaan perlahan dengan serta-merta di sebelah kanan
Berhenti di tengah lorong dan mengundur semula ke simpang sebelumnya
explanation_en: When encountering 'Roundabout (Bulatan) ahead', you must: Slow down, choose the correct approach lane, and give way to traffic circulating from the right.
explanation_ms: Apabila menemui tanda 'Bulatan di hadapan', anda hendaklah: Perlahankan kenderaan, pilih lorong masuk yang betul, dan beri laluan kepada trafik dari sebelah kanan di dalam bulatan.

question_en: What is the safest and legally required driver action when you encounter this sign (Three-lane road ahead with two uphill/overtaking lanes and one oncoming lane)?
question_ms: Apakah tindakan pemandu yang paling selamat dan mematuhi undang-undang apabila menemui tanda ini (Lorong memotong atau mendaki tiga lorong di hadapan)?
options_en: Switch on high-beam headlights and maintain maximum highway speed
Slower vehicles must keep to the far left lane while the middle lane is used only for safe overtaking
Follow less than 1 second behind the vehicle ahead to save space requiring selection of a lower transmission ratio
Ignore the sign outside peak weekday rush hours
options_ms: Pasang lampu tinggi dan kekalkan kelajuan maksimum lebuh raya
Kenderaan perlahan mesti kekal di lorong paling kiri manakala lorong tengah digunakan untuk memotong dengan selamat
Mengekori kurang daripada 1 saat di belakang kenderaan hadapan yang memerlukan pemilihan nisbah gear yang lebih rendah
Abaikan papan tanda ini di luar waktu puncak hari bekerja
explanation_en: When encountering 'Three-lane road ahead with two uphill/overtaking lanes and one oncoming lane', you must: Slower vehicles must keep to the far left lane while the middle lane is used only for safe overtaking.
explanation_ms: Apabila menemui tanda 'Lorong memotong atau mendaki tiga lorong di hadapan (dua lorong sehala dan satu lorong bertentangan)', anda hendaklah: Kenderaan perlahan mesti kekal di lorong paling kiri manakala lorong tengah digunakan untuk memotong dengan selamat.

question_en: What is the safest and legally required driver action when you encounter this sign (Three-lane descending road ahead with two downhill lanes and one uphill oncoming lane)?
question_ms: Apakah tindakan pemandu yang paling selamat dan mematuhi undang-undang apabila menemui tanda ini (Lorong menurun tiga lorong di hadapan)?
options_en: Accelerate quickly to pass the area before oncoming vehicles arrive on high-volume single carriageway trunk routes
Drive on the unpaved road shoulder with hazard lights flashing
Keep left unless overtaking and use engine braking on the downhill gradient

options_ms: Tekan brek kaki sekuat hati pada kelajuan 100 km/j

A front blowout pulls the steering strongly toward the side of the burst tyre, whereas a rear blowout causes the tail/rear of the vehicle to sway or fishtail from side to side

options_ms: Tayar hadapan pecah menghidupkan radio, manakala tayar belakang pecah membuka but

Tayar hadapan pecah akan menarik stereng dengan kuat ke arah sebelah tayar yang pecah, manakala tayar belakang pecah menyebabkan bahagian belakang kereta bergoyang atau membuang ke kiri dan kanan

explanation_en: Front tyre blowouts tug heavily on the steering column toward the flat side; rear blowouts make the rear end fishtail.

Press the accelerator harder to reach a flat road faster
Jump out of the moving vehicle immediately

Release the accelerator, pump the brake pedal rapidly to build hydraulic pressure, shift progressively down into lower gears (engine braking), and apply the handbrake gently while holding the release button
options_ms: Tukar ke gear Neutral (N) dan matikan kunci enjin sehingga stereng terkunci sambil mengekalkan jarak mengekor selamat sekurang-kurangnya 2 saat selepas memeriksa cermin sisi dan titik buta pandangan belakang
Tekan pemecut lebih kuat supaya cepat sampai ke jalan rata
Melompat keluar dari kenderaan yang sedang bergerak

Lepaskan pemecut, pam pedal brek beberapa kali untuk membina tekanan hidraulik, tukar kepada gear rendah secara berperingkat (brek enjin), dan tarik brek tangan secara perlahan sambil menekan butang pelepas
explanation_en: Downshifting for engine braking combined with pumping the footbrake and progressive handbrake application slows the car without locking the rear wheels.
explanation_ms: Menukar ke gear rendah untuk brek enjin bersama mengepam brek kaki dan menarik brek tangan secara terkawal memperlahankan kereta dengan selamat.

question_en: Why must you NEVER turn the ignition key all the way to the LOCK/OFF position while the vehicle is still moving during an emergency?
question_ms: Mengapakah anda DILARANG memusingkan kunci pencucuh sepenuhnya ke kedudukan LOCK/OFF semasa kenderaan masih sedang bergerak?
options_en: Turning the key to LOCK engages the mechanical steering column lock and cuts off power steering and brake booster vacuum, making it impossible to steer or brake
It makes the headlights shine too brightly

It inflates all airbags automatically after verifying mirrors and shoulder blind spot clear during clear daylight hours on dry tarmac carriageways within designated municipal urban speed restriction zones
It locks the boot lid permanently
options_ms: Memusingkan kunci ke kedudukan LOCK akan mengunci roda stereng secara mekanikal serta mematikan bantuan stereng kuasa dan penggalak brek
Ia menyebabkan lampu hadapan menyala terlalu terang
Ia mengembangkan semua beg udara secara automatik selepas memeriksa cermin sisi dan titik buta pandangan belakang semasa waktu siang cerah pada permukaan jalan berturap kering
Ia mengunci penutup but buat selama-lamanya
explanation_en: Turning the key to LOCK while moving locks the steering wheel solid and eliminates power-assisted braking.
explanation_ms: Mematikan kunci ke kedudukan LOCK semasa kereta bergerak akan mengunci stereng dan menghilangkan bantuan kuasa brek.

question_en: What is the correct emergency procedure if the accelerator pedal sticks down (Pedal Pemecut Tersangkut) and the engine keeps revving?
question_ms: Apakah tindakan kecemasan yang betul sekiranya pedal pemecut tersangkut dan kelajuan enjin terus meningkat?
options_en: Reach down under the dashboard with both hands while looking at the floor at 100 km/h
Shift directly into Reverse (R) at highway speed

Shift the transmission into Neutral (N) immediately (or depress the clutch pedal fully in a manual car) to disconnect engine power from the wheels, apply the brakes steadily, and pull over safely to the left shoulder before shutting off the engine
Close your eyes and wait for the fuel tank to run dry
options_ms: Tunduk ke bawah papan pemuka dengan kedua-dua tangan sambil memandang lantai pada kelajuan 100 km/j
Tukar terus kepada gear Undur (R) pada kelajuan tinggi

Tukar gear kepada Neutral (N) dengan segera (atau tekan pedal cekam sepenuhnya bagi kereta manual) untuk memutuskan kuasa enjin ke roda, tekan brek secara terkawal, dan berhenti di bahu jalan kiri sebelum mematikan enjin
Pejamkan mata dan tunggu sehingga tangki minyak kering
explanation_en: Shifting to Neutral (or pressing the clutch) immediately isolates the runaway engine from the drive wheels while keeping power steering and brakes active until you stop safely.
explanation_ms: Menukar ke gear Neutral (atau menekan cekam) memutuskan kuasa enjin daripada roda dengan segera sambil mengekalkan fungsi stereng dan brek sehingga kereta berhenti di bahu jalan.

question_en: If your vehicle's engine temperature gauge climbs into the red 'H' (Hot) zone or steam billows from under the bonnet, what must you do?
question_ms: Sekiranya jarum meter suhu enjin naik ke zon merah 'H' (Panas) atau wap air keluar dari bawah bonet, apakah yang mesti anda lakukan?
options_en: Unscrew the radiator cap immediately with bare hands while steam is hissing

Pull over safely to the left shoulder, switch off the engine, and wait until the engine cools down completely BEFORE attempting to open the radiator cap (opening a hot pressurized cap causes severe scalding)

Pour ice-cold water over the hot cast-iron engine block immediately within designated municipal urban speed restriction zones when approaching busy pedestrian priority crossing areas provided hazard warning lights are activated beforehand
Accelerate to 110 km/h so wind cools the engine faster
options_ms: Buka penutup radiator serta-merta dengan tangan kosong ketika wap sedang memancut

Berhenti dengan selamat di bahu jalan kiri, matikan enjin, dan tunggu sehingga enjin sejuk sepenuhnya SEBELUM membuka penutup radiator (membuka penutup radiator yang panas bertekanan tinggi boleh menyebabkan melecur teruk)

Simbah air ais sejuk ke atas blok enjin yang sedang panas terik di dalam zon had laju bandar pihak berkuasa tempatan apabila menghampiri persimpangan sibuk atau lintasan pejalan kaki dengan syarat lampu amaran kecemasan dinyalakan terlebih dahulu
Pecut kepada 110 km/j supaya angin menyejukkan enjin dengan lebih cepat
explanation_en: A hot cooling system is under high pressure; opening the radiator cap before it cools causes boiling coolant to erupt violently.
explanation_ms: Sistem penyejukan yang panas berada di bawah tekanan tinggi; membuka penutup radiator ketika masih panas akan menyebabkan air mendidih tersembur keluar.

question_en: If your vehicle breaks down on a highway or expressway, how far behind the vehicle should you place the red reflective Warning Triangle (Segi Tiga Amaran)?
question_ms: Sekiranya kenderaan anda mengalami kerosakan di lebuh raya, pada jarak berapakah di belakang kenderaan anda patut meletakkan Segi Tiga Amaran pemantul cahaya?
options_en: Resting directly against the rear number plate (0 metres) when approaching busy pedestrian priority crossing areas provided hazard warning lights are activated beforehand
Inside the boot with the lid closed
At least 45 metres behind the vehicle on an expressway/highway (or at least 15–30 metres on a normal town road) so approaching drivers have time to react
In the middle of the opposite oncoming carriageway
options_ms: Disandarkan rapat pada nombor plat belakang (0 meter) apabila menghampiri persimpangan sibuk atau lintasan pejalan kaki dengan syarat lampu amaran kecemasan dinyalakan terlebih dahulu
Di dalam but kereta dengan penutup but ditutup
Sekurang-kurangnya 45 meter di belakang kenderaan di lebuh raya (atau sekurang-kurangnya 15–30 meter di jalan biasa) supaya pemandu dari arah belakang sempat bertindak balas
Di tengah-tengah lorong jalan arah bertentangan
explanation_en: Placing the warning triangle at least 45 m behind a broken-down vehicle on a high-speed highway gives approaching traffic early visual warning.
explanation_ms: Meletakkan segi tiga amaran sekurang-kurangnya 45 meter di belakang kenderaan yang rosak di lebuh raya memberi amaran awal kepada trafik yang menghampiri.

question_en: If your vehicle breaks down on an expressway emergency lane, where should you and your passengers wait after switching on hazard lights and placing the warning triangle?
question_ms: Sekiranya kenderaan anda rosak di lorong kecemasan lebuh raya, di manakah anda dan penumpang harus menunggu selepas memasang lampu kecemasan dan meletakkan segi tiga amaran?
options_en: Sit inside the car in the emergency lane with seatbelts unfastened provided hazard warning lights are activated beforehand unless directed otherwise by an authorised traffic officer
Exit the vehicle via the LEFT passenger doors and stand well behind the steel guardrail on the grass embankment, away from live traffic and upstream of the car
Stand in the right overtaking lane waving a handkerchief
Sit on the rear bumper of the broken-down car
options_ms: Duduk di dalam kereta di lorong kecemasan sambil bermain telefon dengan syarat lampu amaran kecemasan dinyalakan terlebih dahulu melainkan diarahkan sebaliknya oleh pegawai trafik yang bertugas
Keluar melalui pintu sebelah KIRI dan berdiri di belakang penghadang besi (guardrail) di tebing selamat, jauh daripada aliran trafik serta kenderaan yang rosak
Berdiri di lorong memotong kanan sambil melambai sapu tangan
Duduk di atas bampar belakang kereta yang rosak tersebut
explanation_en: Standing behind the guardrail after exiting through the left doors protects passengers if a stray vehicle veers into the emergency lane.
explanation_ms: Berdiri di belakang penghadang besi selepas keluar melalui pintu kiri melindungi penumpang sekiranya kenderaan lain terbabas ke lorong kecemasan.

question_en: If the bonnet (hood) of your car suddenly flies open and blocks your forward view while driving, what should you do?
question_ms: Sekiranya bonet hadapan kereta anda tiba-tiba terbuka dan menghalang pandangan ke hadapan semasa sedang memandu, apakah tindakan yang betul?
options_en: Swerve blindly into the right oncoming lane at full throttle

Brake smoothly without swerving, look through the gap beneath the hinged edge of the bonnet or use your left window and side mirrors as a guide, switch on hazard/left signal, and pull over to the left shoulder
Open the driver's door and stand on the sill at 80 km/h
Pull the handbrake hard to spin the car 180 degrees
options_ms: Memusing stereng secara membuta tuli ke lorong kanan sambil menekan minyak

Tekan brek secara terkawal tanpa memusing stereng secara mengejut, lihat melalui ruang di bawah celah bonet atau gunakan panduan tingkap kiri serta cermin sisi, beri isyarat kiri, dan berhenti di bahu jalan
Buka pintu pemandu dan berdiri di tepi pintu pada kelajuan 80 km/j
Tarik brek tangan sekuat hati supaya kereta berpusing 180 darjah
explanation_en: Looking through the gap beneath the bonnet or along the left kerb line via the side window lets you guide the car safely onto the shoulder.
explanation_ms: Melihat melalui celah di bawah bonet atau berpandukan garisan tepi jalan di tingkap sisi membolehkan anda mengawal kereta berhenti di bahu jalan.

question_en: If smoke or small flames start coming from your vehicle's engine bay while driving, what is the correct emergency sequence?
question_ms: Sekiranya asap tebal atau api kecil mula kelihatan keluar dari ruang enjin kenderaan semasa memandu, apakah urutan tindakan kecemasan yang betul?
options_en: Drive into the nearest petrol station forecourt and open the bonnet wide

Pull over immediately to a safe spot away from petrol stations/buildings, switch off the ignition, evacuate all passengers to a safe distance, call 999 (Bomba), and do NOT fling the bonnet wide open (which feeds oxygen to the fire)
Pour petrol onto the engine block to cool it down

Stay locked inside the cabin with the air-conditioner on recirculation provided the forward roadway is completely unobstructed while maintaining at least a 2-second safe trailing interval after verifying mirrors and shoulder blind spot clear
options_ms: Pandu masuk ke kawasan pam stesen minyak terdekat dan buka bonet seluas-luasnya

Berhenti segera di tempat selamat jauh daripada stesen minyak/bangunan, matikan enjin, arahkan semua penumpang keluar ke tempat selamat, hubungi 999 (Bomba), dan JANGAN membuka bonet secara luas (kerana oksigen akan menyemarakkan api)
Curahkan petrol ke atas blok enjin untuk menyejukkannya

Kekal berkunci di dalam kabin sambil menghidupkan penyaman udara dengan syarat laluan hadapan lapang daripada sebarang trafik sambil mengekalkan jarak mengekor selamat sekurang-kurangnya 2 saat selepas memeriksa cermin sisi dan titik buta pandangan belakang
explanation_en: Opening a burning bonnet feeds fresh oxygen and causes a flashover; evacuate passengers first and use a dry-powder extinguisher through a small crack only if safe.
explanation_ms: Membuka bonet secara luas membekalkan oksigen yang menyebabkan api menyambar dengan marak; utamakan keselamatan nyawa penumpang dan hubungi Bomba di talian 999.

question_en: Under Section 15(1) APJ 1987, what rule applies to a Learner's Driving Licence (LDL) holder driving a motor car (Class D/DA) without a qualified driving instructor seated beside them?
question_ms: Di bawah Seksyen 15(1) APJ 1987, apakah peraturan bagi pemegang Lesen Belajar Memandu (LDL) yang memandu kereta (Kelas D/DA) tanpa pengajar memandu bertauliah duduk di sebelahnya?
options_en: It is permitted on Sundays between 8:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. while maintaining at least a 2-second safe trailing interval after verifying mirrors and shoulder blind spot clear
It is an offence punishable by a compound up to RM300 or court prosecution, as LDL car learners must always be supervised by a certified instructor
It is allowed if the learner drives below 40 km/h
It is allowed if a friend with a PDL sits in the rear seat
options_ms: Ia dibenarkan pada hari Ahad antara jam 8:00 pagi hingga 6:00 malam sambil mengekalkan jarak mengekor selamat sekurang-kurangnya 2 saat selepas memeriksa cermin sisi dan titik buta pandangan belakang
Ia merupakan kesalahan yang boleh dikenakan kompaun sehingga RM300 atau tindakan mahkamah kerana pemegang LDL kereta wajib diawasi oleh pengajar bertauliah
Ia dibenarkan jika pemegang LDL memandu di bawah 40 km/j
Ia dibenarkan jika rakan berlesen PDL duduk di kerusi belakang
explanation_en: Section 15(1) APJ 1987 requires LDL car learners to be accompanied by a qualified instructor at all times on the road.
explanation_ms: Seksyen 15(1) APJ 1987 mewajibkan pemegang LDL kereta ditemani pengajar bertauliah sepanjang masa semasa memandu.

question_en: Under Section 15(1) APJ 1987, what rule applies to a Learner's Driving Licence (LDL) motorcycle rider (Class B2/B) regarding carrying a pillion passenger?
question_ms: Di bawah Seksyen 15(1) APJ 1987, apakah peraturan bagi penunggang motosikal Lesen Belajar Memandu (LDL Kelas B2/B) berkaitan membawa pembonceng?
options_en: They may carry one pillion passenger if both wear helmets
An LDL motorcycle rider is strictly prohibited from carrying any pillion passenger at any time
They may carry family members within housing estates after verifying mirrors and shoulder blind spot clear
They may carry a pillion passenger during daylight hours only
options_ms: Mereka boleh membawa seorang pembonceng jika kedua-duanya memakai topi keledar
Penunggang motosikal yang memegang lesen LDL dilarang sama sekali membawa sebarang pembonceng pada bila-bila masa
Mereka boleh membonceng ahli keluarga di kawasan taman perumahan selepas memeriksa cermin sisi dan titik buta pandangan belakang
Mereka boleh membawa pembonceng pada waktu siang sahaja
explanation_en: LDL motorcyclists must ride solo with L plates displayed front and rear; carrying any pillion passenger is an offence under Section 15.
explanation_ms: Pemegang LDL motosikal wajib menunggang secara bersendirian dengan plat L di hadapan dan belakang; membawa pembonceng adalah satu kesalahan.

question_en: Under Section 20 APJ 1987, what happens if a driver operates a motor vehicle on a road while their Motor Vehicle Licence (LKM / Road Tax) has expired?
question_ms: Di bawah Seksyen 20 APJ 1987, apakah implikasi undang-undang jika seseorang memandu kenderaan yang Lesen Kenderaan Bermotor (LKM / Cukai Jalan) telah tamat tempoh?
options_en: No offence occurs during the first 12 months after expiry
Road tax is only required for commercial lorries
It is an offence carrying up to a RM300 compound, and driving with an LKM expired for a prolonged period also invalidates motor insurance coverage
An expired LKM is valid as long as the car is washed
options_ms: Tiada kesalahan berlaku dalam tempoh 12 bulan pertama selepas tamat
Cukai jalan hanya diwajibkan untuk lori perdagangan sahaja
Ia merupakan kesalahan dengan kompaun sehingga RM300, malah memandu tanpa LKM yang sah turut menjejaskan perlindungan insurans kenderaan
LKM tamat tempoh masih sah selagi kereta dicuci bersih
explanation_en: Every motor vehicle on a public road must have a current, valid LKM (Motor Vehicle Licence) and valid motor insurance.
explanation_ms: Setiap kenderaan bermotor di jalan awam wajib mempunyai Lesen Kenderaan Bermotor (LKM) dan perlindungan insurans yang masih sah.

question_en: Under Section 50(1) APJ 1987, what offence is committed if a person takes and drives away a motor vehicle without the owner's consent?
question_ms: Di bawah Seksyen 50(1) APJ 1987, apakah kesalahan yang dilakukan jika seseorang mengambil dan memandu kenderaan bermotor tanpa keizinan pemiliknya?
options_en: A RM20 municipal parking fee
Allowed if the tank is refilled with petrol afterward
Permitted if the driver holds a valid CDL within designated municipal urban speed restriction zones when approaching busy pedestrian priority crossing areas
Unlawful interference / taking a vehicle without owner's consent, prosecuted in court with fine or imprisonment
options_ms: Bayaran parkir majlis sebanyak RM20 sahaja
Dibenarkan jika minyak petrol diisi semula selepas digunakan
Dibenarkan jika pemandu tersebut mempunyai lesen CDL yang sah di dalam zon had laju bandar pihak berkuasa tempatan apabila menghampiri persimpangan sibuk atau lintasan pejalan kaki
Mengambil dan memandu kenderaan tanpa izin pemilik, yang boleh didakwa di mahkamah dengan hukuman denda atau penjara
explanation_en: Taking or driving a motor vehicle without the owner's consent is a statutory offence under Section 50(1) APJ 1987.
explanation_ms: Mengambil atau memandu kenderaan tanpa kebenaran pemilik merupakan kesalahan di bawah Seksyen 50(1) APJ 1987.

question_en: Under Section 53(1) APJ 1987, what offence is committed when a person hangs onto or rides on the exterior of a moving motor vehicle?
question_ms: Di bawah Seksyen 53(1) APJ 1987, apakah kesalahan yang dilakukan apabila seseorang bergayut atau menumpang di bahagian luar kenderaan yang sedang bergerak?
options_en: Permitted on garbage trucks and private pickup tailgates at 90 km/h
Allowed for passengers when all interior seats are full
Unlawfully hanging onto or getting onto a moving vehicle without lawful authority, punishable by a compound or court fine
Exempted on rural roads when approaching busy pedestrian priority crossing areas provided hazard warning lights are activated beforehand
options_ms: Dibenarkan di belakang pikap persendirian pada kelajuan 90 km/j
Dibenarkan bagi penumpang apabila semua tempat duduk dalam penuh
Bergayut atau menaiki bahagian luar kenderaan yang sedang bergerak tanpa kuasa yang sah, boleh dikenakan kompaun atau denda mahkamah
Dikecualikan di jalan luar bandar apabila menghampiri persimpangan sibuk atau lintasan pejalan kaki dengan syarat lampu amaran kecemasan dinyalakan terlebih dahulu
explanation_en: Hanging onto the exterior or tailgate of a moving vehicle is dangerous and prohibited under Section 53 APJ 1987.
explanation_ms: Bergayut pada bahagian luar kenderaan yang sedang bergerak adalah berbahaya dan dilarang di bawah Seksyen 53 APJ 1987.

question_en: Under Section 58 APJ 1987, what authority do Police Officers and JPJ Officers have regarding inspecting a motor vehicle's weight and mechanical condition?
question_ms: Di bawah Seksyen 58 APJ 1987, apakah kuasa yang diberikan kepada Pegawai Polis dan Pegawai JPJ berkaitan pemeriksaan berat dan keadaan mekanikal kenderaan?
options_en: They may only inspect vehicles on leap years
They may require any motor vehicle to be stopped, weighed at a weighbridge, and inspected for roadworthiness compliance
They require a 30-day written appointment from the vehicle owner
Private cars cannot be inspected by JPJ or Police provided hazard warning lights are activated beforehand unless directed otherwise by an authorised traffic officer
options_ms: Mereka hanya boleh memeriksa kenderaan pada tahun lompat
Mereka berkuasa mengarahkan mana-mana kenderaan bermotor berhenti untuk ditimbang berat muatan dan diperiksa tahap keselamatan mekanikalnya
Mereka memerlukan temu janji bertulis 30 hari daripada pemilik
Kereta persendirian tidak boleh diperiksa oleh JPJ atau Polis dengan syarat lampu amaran kecemasan dinyalakan terlebih dahulu melainkan diarahkan sebaliknya oleh pegawai trafik yang bertugas
explanation_en: Refusing to stop or refusing to take a vehicle to a JPJ weighing/enforcement station when directed is an offence under the Act.
explanation_ms: Keengganan berhenti atau enggan membawa kenderaan ke stesen timbang/penguatkuasa JPJ apabila diarahkan adalah satu kesalahan.

question_en: Under Section 108 APJ 1987, how does the law treat displaying a forged road tax (LKM), altered driving licence, or cloned registration plate?
question_ms: Di bawah Seksyen 108 APJ 1987, bagaimanakah undang-undang menetapkan kesalahan mempamerkan LKM palsu, lesen memandu dipinda, atau nombor pendaftaran klon?
options_en: A minor RM30 compound payable online
A severe non-compoundable court offence carrying heavy fines (RM5,000 to RM20,000) and/or imprisonment
Permitted temporarily while waiting for a replacement card
No penalty if the vehicle has valid insurance
options_ms: Kompaun kecil RM30 yang boleh dibayar secara dalam talian
Kesalahan mahkamah yang amat berat (tidak boleh dikompaun) yang membawa denda tinggi (RM5,000 hingga RM20,000) dan/atau penjara
Dibenarkan buat sementara waktu sementara menunggu kad gantian
Tiada hukuman jika kenderaan mempunyai insurans yang sah
explanation_en: Falsifying or displaying cloned/forged registration marks, licences, or insurance certificates is a major offence under Section 108.
explanation_ms: Memalsukan atau menggunakan nombor pendaftaran klon, lesen palsu atau dokumen palsu ialah kesalahan berat di bawah Seksyen 108.

question_en: Under Rule 5 of the Road Traffic Rules 1959, what must a slow-moving vehicle (such as a heavy lorry, tractor, or crane) do when holding up a queue of faster traffic behind it?
question_ms: Di bawah Kaedah 5 Kaedah-Kaedah Lalu Lintas Jalan 1959, apakah yang mesti dilakukan oleh pemandu kenderaan bergerak perlahan apabila menghalang deretan trafik di belakangnya?
options_en: Keep as close as safe to the left edge of the road and pull aside where practicable to allow faster following traffic to overtake safely
Drive down the center line to stop anyone from overtaking provided the forward roadway is completely unobstructed while maintaining at least a 2-second safe trailing interval
Accelerate beyond the lorry speed limit to 130 km/h
Switch on right turn signals continuously to block the lane
options_ms: Memandu serapat yang selamat di sebelah kiri jalan dan memberi ruang apabila sesuai bagi membolehkan trafik yang lebih laju di belakang memotong dengan selamat

Memandu di atas garisan tengah untuk menghalang sesiapa daripada memotong dengan syarat laluan hadapan lapang daripada sebarang trafik sambil mengekalkan jarak mengekor selamat sekurang-kurangnya 2 saat
Pecut melebihi had laju lori sehingga 130 km/j
Memasang lampu isyarat kanan berterusan untuk menutup laluan
explanation_en: Slow-moving vehicles must keep left and facilitate safe overtaking rather than obstructing traffic flow.
explanation_ms: Kenderaan yang bergerak perlahan hendaklah kekal di sebelah kiri dan memudahkan trafik lain memotong dengan selamat.

question_en: Under Rule 8 of the Road Traffic Rules 1959, at which road features is overtaking another moving vehicle strictly prohibited?
question_ms: Di bawah Kaedah 8 Kaedah-Kaedah Lalu Lintas Jalan 1959, di kawasan jalan raya manakah perbuatan memotong kenderaan lain dilarang sama sekali?
options_en: On straight climbing lanes marked with dashed lines

On three-lane expressways during sunny weather while maintaining at least a 2-second safe trailing interval after verifying mirrors and shoulder blind spot clear during clear daylight hours on dry tarmac carriageways
On dual carriageways with a central divider
At blind bends, hill crests, narrow bridges, road intersections/junctions, pedestrian crossings, railway level crossings, and wherever double solid lines or No Overtaking signs exist
options_ms: Di lorong mendaki lurus yang mempunyai garisan putus-putus
Di lebuh raya tiga lorong pada waktu cuaca cerah sambil mengekalkan jarak mengekor selamat sekurang-kurangnya 2 saat selepas memeriksa cermin sisi dan titik buta pandangan belakang
Di jalan berkembar yang mempunyai pembahagi tengah
Di selekoh terlindung, puncak bukit, jambatan sempit, persimpangan jalan, lintasan pejalan kaki, lintasan kereta api, serta di garisan berkembar atau tanda Dilarang Memotong
explanation_en: Rule 8 prohibits overtaking wherever forward visibility is restricted or where conflict points (junctions, crossings, bridges) exist.
explanation_ms: Kaedah 8 melarang perbuatan memotong di mana-mana lokasi yang menghalang jarak penglihatan atau di titik konflik seperti simpang dan lintasan.

question_en: Under Rule 10 of the Road Traffic Rules 1959, what must a driver ensure before opening a vehicle door on the traffic side of a road?
question_ms: Di bawah Kaedah 10 Kaedah-Kaedah Lalu Lintas Jalan 1959, apakah yang mesti dipastikan oleh pemandu atau penumpang sebelum membuka pintu kenderaan di tepi jalan?
options_en: Fling the door wide open immediately without looking back
Open the door first and sound the horn afterward

Approaching motorcyclists are legally required to ride on the footpath after verifying mirrors and shoulder blind spot clear during clear daylight hours on dry tarmac carriageways within designated municipal urban speed restriction zones
Check the side mirror and blind spot first (e.g., using the Dutch Reach with the far hand) to ensure opening the door will not strike or endanger any approaching motorcyclist, cyclist, or vehicle
options_ms: Tolak pintu terbuka seluas-luasnya dengan segera tanpa menoleh ke belakang
Buka pintu dahulu dan bunyikan hon selepas itu
Penunggang motosikal dari arah belakang wajib naik ke laluan pejalan kaki selepas memeriksa cermin sisi dan titik buta pandangan belakang semasa waktu siang cerah pada permukaan jalan berturap kering
Periksa cermin sisi dan titik buta terlebih dahulu bagi memastikan pembukaan pintu tidak melanggar atau membahayakan penunggang motosikal, basikal atau kenderaan yang menghampiri
explanation_en: Carelessly opening a car door into the path of a motorcyclist or cyclist is a frequent cause of severe urban crashes and an offence under the Road Traffic Rules.
explanation_ms: Membuka pintu kenderaan secara cuai di hadapan penunggang motosikal atau basikal ialah punca utama kemalangan di bandar dan merupakan satu kesalahan.

question_en: What is the correct hand technique when pulling up (engaging) and releasing the Handbrake / Parking Brake lever (Brek Tangan)?
question_ms: Apakah cara pengendalian tangan kiri yang betul semasa menarik (menggunakan) dan melepaskan Brek Tangan (Handbrake)?
options_en: Never press the release button when lowering the handbrake

Pull the handbrake lever firmly upward to lock the rear wheels; to release it, pull the lever slightly upward first, press the thumb release button on the tip, and push the lever all the way down to the floor
Use the handbrake as the primary brake at 90 km/h on the highway
Leave the handbrake halfway up while driving so the rear brakes stay warm
options_ms: Jangan tekan butang pelepas semasa menurunkan brek tangan

Tarik tuil brek tangan ke atas dengan kemas untuk mengunci roda belakang; untuk melepaskannya pula, tarik tuil sedikit ke atas, tekan butang pelepas dengan ibu jari, dan turunkan tuil sepenuhnya ke bawah
Gunakan brek tangan sebagai brek utama pada kelajuan 90 km/j di lebuh raya
Biarkan brek tangan separuh tertarik semasa memandu supaya brek belakang panas
explanation_en: Driving with the handbrake partially engaged overheats the rear brake linings and triggers the red (!) brake warning light on the dashboard.
explanation_ms: Memandu dalam keadaan brek tangan belum diturunkan sepenuhnya akan menyebabkan brek belakang menjadi panas, berbau hangit dan cepat haus.

question_en: In the KPP02 practical assessment, what happens if a candidate forgets to fasten their 3-point Safety Seatbelt before moving the vehicle off in Bahagian II or Bahagian III?
question_ms: Dalam Ujian Amali JPJ Bahagian II (Litar) atau Bahagian III (Jalan Raya), apakah kesan terhadap keputusan ujian sekiranya calon bergerak memandu tanpa memakai Tali Pinggang Keledar?
options_en: Only 1 minor mark is deducted and the candidate still passes while maintaining a firm two-handed grip on the steering wheel
The examiner fastens the seatbelt for the candidate with no penalty
It is recorded as a Mandatory Error (Kesalahan Mandatori) resulting in immediate failure of that test section
Seatbelts are optional inside the driving institute circuit
options_ms: Hanya 1 markah kecil ditolak dan calon masih lulus sambil memegang stereng dengan kemas menggunakan kedua-dua belah tangan
Penguji akan memakaikan tali pinggang keledar tanpa sebarang penalti
Ia dikira sebagai Kesalahan Mandatori yang menyebabkan calon GAGAL serta-merta dalam bahagian ujian tersebut
Pemakaian tali pinggang keledar adalah pilihan semata-mata di dalam litar
explanation_en: Fastening the seatbelt until it clicks during RSM before moving off is mandatory in both the circuit (Bahagian II) and road (Bahagian III) tests.
explanation_ms: Memakai tali pinggang keledar dengan kemas semasa RSM sebelum kenderaan bergerak adalah syarat wajib (mandatori) di dalam litar dan di jalan raya.
source_url: KPP Kelas DA/D (2021), KPP02 & KPP03, m/s 202, 219, 250

question_en: Why is the Supplemental Restraint System (SRS) Airbag called 'Supplemental' — and why can an airbag NEVER replace wearing the 3-point safety seatbelt?
question_ms: Mengapakah Beg Udara Keselamatan (SRS Airbag) dinamakan sistem pelengkap ('Supplemental') dan TIDAK BOLEH menggantikan pemakaian Tali Pinggang Keledar Tiga Penjuru?
